Title: Product Safety Statement
Description__c:
Online Marketplaces- Product Safety Message:

The Office for Product Safety and Standards (OPSS), part of the Department for Business and Trade, has issued an important Product Safety Message asking the public to check who they are buying from.

Buying products online from businesses that don’t give a UK address increases the risk to consumers. Online platforms are not always the seller of the products on their websites and often act as an intermediary between an independent company and the buyer.

For more information, visit the OPSS website.

Title: Property Scams
Description__c:
If you are looking for your next home, Gumtree offers thousands of listings for properties to share, rent and buy. However, growing demand for housing has seen an increase in the level of rental fraud, with would-be tenants paying an upfront fee for a non-existent property. While the overwhelming majority of listings on our platform are trustworthy, it is important to be aware of potential scams when searching for a new property.

 

Fake Listings

If a property feels a little too perfect, the listing could be fake. Scammers often copy genuine listings to dupe their victims and add attractive extras to lure you in. Watch out for pricing that’s lower than the market average, any ‘too good to be true’ offers such as free moving services or a lack of images/information about the property.

 

Unable to View Property or Meet the Landlord or Letting Agent

An immediate red flag should be raised if the landlord or letting agent only offers images of the property or says the space is unavailable to physically view. Also be cautious if the landlord or letting agent does not want to meet in person or virtually.

 

Paying an Upfront Fee

Genuine landlords and letting agents will not ask for a deposit prior to viewing a property. Fraudsters may claim the money is protected by the Tenancy Deposit Scheme, but it is not.

 

No Screening Process for Tenants

Be suspicious if you are not required to provide evidence as to who you are and whether you have the financial means to pay for the property listed. 

 

Pressure to pay quickly

Take the time you need to make the decision that is right for you. If you feel undue pressure to make a decision or hand over money, you might be best to walk away.
 

Protect yourself from rental fraud by

  • Visiting the property before paying any deposit
  • Only paying a deposit once you are certain the landlord or letting agent is genuine.
  • Asking for copies of tenancy agreements and any safety certificates such as Gas Electricity or HMO Licence.
  • Checking to see whether the owner has membership with schemes such as National Approved Letting Scheme (NALS), Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) or Association of Residential Letting Agents (ARLA).

 

Sex for rent

Upon arriving at the property, if the landlord implies or explicitly indicates that the accommodation would be discounted or free in return for sexual relations, leave immediately. 'Sex for rent' is illegal and listings/landlords should be reported to the police who will also be able to offer support if you have been a victim of the practice.

 

 

For further information about rental fraud, visit Action Fraud.

Title: Report Reply
Description__c:
Gumtree is a community and we work hand-in-hand with users to help maintain the safety of the platform. 

Reporting a message

If you think you have received a suspicious or inappropriate message, you can report it directly to us by using the report reply function which is available on the web version of Gumtree (and soon on iOS & Android app). You will find the report reply button at the bottom of each message, under more options. You can report messages for the following reasons:

  • Fraud
  • Abuse or Harassment
  • Adult or inappropriate
  • Phishing attempt
  • Spam
  • No reply
  • No show

Be sure to include as much information as possible, to help our team with their investigations. All reports remain anonymous.

Please be aware that whilst our team will review every report that is made, we will not communicate the result of our investigations. If you wish to speak with one of our team about a message you have received, please visit our contact us page.

It is also difficult for our team to mediate on issues such as buyer seller disputes, reports of no shows and reports stating no reply. However, we value these reports as they help us to create a better Gumtree for our users in future.

Title: Reporting Banner Adverts on Gumtree
Description__c:
While we strive to prevent 3rd party banner ads that violate Gumtree policies from running, it is possible for some ads to slip through our restrictions occasionally. To maintain a safe marketplace, we encourage all users to promptly notify us whenever they come across inappropriate, offensive, or misleading 3rd party banner ads.

What is a Banner Ad?

  • 3rd party banner ads are typically placed by external advertisers and may not be directly related to Gumtree's own services or products
  • These ads may promote products, services, or websites that are unrelated to the Gumtree platform
  • 3rd party banner ads may also be labelled with an "Ad" or "Sponsored" tag to indicate their commercial nature. Look for this label, usually located near or within the ad

When to report a banner ad:

  • You might want to report an ad if it violates one or more of these Gumtree advertising policies, such as:
    • Copyright infringement, trade mark or counterfeit violations
    • Tobacco
    • Illegal goods/services
    • Misleading advertiser claims
    • Nudity in an image ad
    • Dangerous products or services
    • Weapons
    • Phishing
    • Legal and regulatory violations
  • Even if you find an ad to be offensive or misleading but it doesn't directly violate these policies, we encourage you to report it. Our aim is to ensure Gumtree remains a safe and reliable online marketplace.

To report a banner ad on Gumtree:

  • Take a screenshot of the ad, and make sure the Gumtree page content and the URL are visible.
  • Depending on your device, follow the relevant step below:
    • Desktop web: Right-click the ad and select “Copy Link Address”
    • Mobile web: Long-press on the ad and select “Copy Link Address”
    • Mobile App: Click on the ad and copy the URL or take a screenshot of the entire page. 
    •  If you are uncomfortable clicking on the ad, you can skip this step on the app.
  • Navigate to the Gumtree "Contact Us" section or click here.
  • Click "Contact Us."
  • Provide a detailed description of the issue, including the reasons for reporting the ad, advertiser name, product being promoted, and any additional helpful details.
  • Submit the report by clicking the relevant button or following the provided instructions.
  • After submitting the report, you will receive an automated response from Gumtree. Reply to this email and attach the screenshot you took.

Is there a reporting timeframe?

  • Report as soon as possible to expedite action. The sooner Gumtree is notified, the quicker we can investigate and address the issue.

Can ads be reported for other reasons?

  • Yes, users can report any ads. Remember, reporting banner ads helps create a safer and more enjoyable Gumtree experience for all users.

Title: Protecting Pets by Making Our Pets Category Harder to Use - 2023 Statement
Description__c:
Gumtree is, and always has been, firmly committed to making sure our platform is as safe as possible for rehoming pets. In August 2018, we introduced a charge for all adverts listed in our pets category. The decision to move away from our usual ‘free for all users’ model was taken to further safeguard our users and the animals involved.

A complicated issue

The truth is that the rehoming and selling of pets online is a contentious and emotional issue. While we are known as a nation of animal lovers, there continues to be a small minority who look to exploit pets for financial gain, with no regard for their health, wellbeing or safety. Because of this criminal activity, there have been calls for an outright ban on the sale of animals online.

Through our ongoing work with the relevant authorities and stakeholders – such as the Pet Advertising Advisory Group (PAAG) and the Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs (DEFRA) – we know that a blanket ban is, unfortunately, not that simple. The reality is that without strong enforcement, the sale of pets would be pushed underground; out of sight of animal welfare bodies and policing/standards organisations working hard to ensure standards are met. New sites selling pets would also likely emerge and, unlike Gumtree, may not be as willing to engage with standards that seek to improve the welfare of the animals involved.

To deter unscrupulous operators from misusing the platform and discourage the ‘casual’ trading of animals online, we introduced a paywall to the pets category in 2018. Forcing users to pay even a small amount enhances the ability of law enforcement to track down users who are engaged in suspected illegal activity and reduces the number of pets sold unscrupulously online.

Working with experts

At Gumtree, we take our responsibilities towards protecting animal welfare seriously. We work with multiple animal welfare charities, including the RSPCA, and we have been an active contributor to the work of PAAG – which brings animal welfare groups, vets, trade associations and online classified sites together to promote responsible pet advertising - for many years. Gumtree meets the 27 minimum standards set out by PAAG for websites offering pets for sale via online adverts. The standards help ensure animals are treated with respect and care.

If you don’t want to pay….

Don’t use us. It is everyone’s responsibility to ensure the welfare of animals in the UK and if you don’t feel comfortable rehoming your pets on Gumtree please look to accredited local shelters or rehoming centres instead. You can find additional options on the PAAG and RSPCA websites.

For additional questions about the Gumtree pet paywall, or other issues, please contact us for more information.

Auction Process 

For Sellers

Once you express an interest in receiving offers from dealers you will receive an email providing you with information on how to complete your listing for the Dealer Auction. Once complete, your Dealer Auction listing will then be made available to dealers and you will receive an email informing you of the highest bid. Sellers agree and acknowledge that: (a) they are solely responsible for the accuracy, quality, safety and legality of information provided in a Dealer Auction listing, and, (b) bids are received from third party dealers and not from Gumtree.

For Dealers

Dealers will be given access to a dashboard allowing them to review and bid on vehicles available in the Dealer Auction. If a dealer has bid, the dealer will receive an email informing them that the auction has ended and request that they check the dashboard to confirm if they have won.

Between organising collection and arriving the dealer should inform the seller of who is collecting the vehicle. When the dealer or representative arrives to collect the vehicle, they need to make sure to provide identification.
Purchase Process For Sellers and Dealers

The seller will be sent the contact details of the dealer with the winning bid (the highest offer above the seller's reserve price). It is the seller’s responsibility to contact the dealer and for the parties to arrange inspection, payment and collection of the vehicle. If the vehicle is not as described or the seller has not disclosed important information that would affect the value of the car then the seller accepts that this could affect the value of the bid(s) or result in a bid being withdrawn.

Any contract for sale of a vehicle is between the seller and dealer only.
A Dealer Auction listing or bid may be subject to certain conditions and it is the sole responsibility of the seller and dealer to disclose such conditions during the Dealer Auction process prior to any sale taking place and it is sole responsibility of the dealer to individually inspect the vehicle, verify the information provided by the seller and completing any necessary due diligence.

As part of the survey you will be invited to participate in an optional interview to share more about your experience.

Title: Delivery Scams
Description__c:
Sometimes your Gumtree good finds may be too big or bulky to collect in person. To help bring your precious purchase home, we’ve partnered with AnyVan to provide affordable and sustainable delivery options. 


AnyVan offers instant quotes, insurance up to £50,000, price match guarantee and the ability to track the driver. Plus, by making the most of existing journeys and empty space, you never pay the full price for a journey, reducing fuel consumption and CO2 emissions. 

When considering a delivery, it’s important to watch out for scams and phishing attempts. In addition to the normal red flags, be wary if a seller:
 
  • Asks for payment details to book a delivery on your behalf
  • Says they have paid for a delivery and encourages you to click a link via email or text

Or if a buyer:
 
  • Claims they have paid for the item and asks the seller to confirm the sale or arrange a delivery via a URL they provide via text or email
It’s always best practice to check the URL address before clicking on a link, particularly if the message is unexpected.

Any communication indicating that a payment needs to be made via Gumtree should be treated with suspicion as it’s not possible to process payments on our site, except in our motors category.

We always recommend buyers always book their own deliveries and use a registered delivery company or click directly to the AnyVan site from the banners on the Gumtree platform.

Remember, if in doubt, walk away from the purchase.

Title: The new Gumtree app explained
Description__c:
Millions of people across the UK use Gumtree to find what they need and sell what they don't.

We are continually investing in our tech to make it easier to buy, sell and connect and as part of our modernisation plans, we have launched a new app to make it faster, simpler and easier to trade locally.

What changes have been made to the new App?

  • A brand new look - with a clean, simple and modernised design
  • More user friendly - intuitive navigation, making it easier to post your ads, find and reply, and manage your account
  • Better performance - the app will be faster and more responsive
  • Improved search - more filters and attributes to find what you are looking for
  • Revamped chat experience - with read receipts, typing indicators and instant messaging


FAQs

I already have the Gumtree app. How can I get the new version?

  • If you have automatic updates enabled, the new app will be installed to your device as soon as it becomes available
  • If automatic updates are disabled, you can update to the new app by going to the App Store or Google Play Store and searching for Gumtree

How do I download the Gumtree app?

The Gumtree app is available to download for free from both the App Store for Apple devices, and Google Play Store for Android devices

The Gumtree app isn't working

If the app isn't working, the best thing to do is turn it off and on again. If this does not work, then we recommend:

  • Checking to see if an update is available for the app
  • Ensuring your device operating system is up to date
  • Deleting and reinstalling the Gumtree app

Will my old login details work on the new app?

Yes, all login details will remain the same, and you will still be able to access your original account on the new app

Will my saved searches be transferred to the new app?

Yes, as long as you have logged into your original account

How do I delete messages on the new app?

To delete a message, you first need to navigate to Messages by selecting the message icon at the bottom of the screen. You can then delete the entire message history with another user by swiping left on the conversation you wish to delete. Swiping left will reveal a trash to indicate the conversation is being deleted. (Please note, individual messages in a conversation cannot be deleted once sent).

We are currently aware of an issue where deleted conversations are reappearing in Messages. We are working to fix this.

How do I remove the Beta version of the app?

iOS

  1. Uninstall the beta app from your iOS device
  2. Visit the App Store and install the latest version of the Gumtree app (current version 17.8.1)
Android
  1. Uninstall the beta app from your Android device
  2. Visit the Google Play Store, and select 'leave beta'. Please note this may take several hours to process.
  3. Once completed, install the Gumtree app

I am experiencing other issues with the new Gumtree app, or have found a bug

If you are experiencing technical issues, or have found a bug, then please do not hesitate to contact our Customer Service team, where our support agents will be more than happy to assist you.

Title: Gumtree Complaints Process
Description__c:
Complaints Process

  1. Scope
  2. This Complaints Process (“Process”) applies to complaints received by Gumtree in the UK from consumers or business users (“Customer”) regarding the use of the Gumtree website, application, services and/or tools.
  3. Purpose
    1. The purpose of this Process is to outline how various types of complaints are handled by Gumtree’s Customer Service Team (“Customer Service”).
  4. Objectives
    1. This Process aims to achieve the following objectives:
  1. That complaints are duly considered and adequately addressed;
  2. That complaints are processed swiftly and effectively (taking into account their importance and complexity); and
  3. That the outcome of each complaint is clearly communicated to the user on an individual basis.
  1. Related Policies
    1. This Process should be read in conjunction with Gumtree’s safety information available on the Gumtree Help Desk at https://help.Gumtree.com/s/safety This information provides additional details regarding safety on Gumtree, including reporting in inappropriate activity.
  2. Definition of a Complaint
    1. A complaint occurs when a Customer contacts Gumtree to report a problem or issue that requires resolution by Customer Service or other relevant team.
    2. To submit a complaint, the Customer must provide clear details in writing, using email or live chat, or over the phone, including:
(a) their name and email address;
(b) detailed reasons for the complaint, supported by any relevant evidence; and
(c) requested outcome for the resolution of the complaint.
    1. It is important to differentiate a complaint from a query or problem that can easily be resolved by Customer Service, provided it is within their remit and authority (e.g., user information, timelines for technical issues, etc.).
    2. Complaints may be raised by a Customer concerning the consequences of breaching Gumtree’s terms and conditions (e.g., posting an ad that violates Gumtree policies, resulting in a service suspension). Such complaints must be responded to by providing a link to the breached policy and informing the Customer on successful posting.
  2. Logging the Complaint
    1. Complaints from Consumers are typically received through the Gumtree Help Desk for appropriate action by Customer Service.
    2. If a Consumer complaint is received via the business complaints email address, or other channel, it will be reassigned to Customer Service.
  3. Response Timeframes
    1. Customer Service will aim to:
  1. acknowledge a complaint within 1 working day of receipt; and
  2. resolve the complaint within 24 hours of receipt.
    1. However, if a complaint cannot be resolved within 24 hours, it will be escalated following the escalation process outlined below, with an aim to resolution within 7 working days
  1. Escalation of Complaints
    1. The following table outlines the escalation process:
      Customer TypeBusiness AreaLevel 1
      First contact point      		Level 2
      After 1 working day      		Level 3
      After a further 2 working days      		Final Level
      After a further 5 working days
      ConsumerGumtreeCustomer Service TeamSupervisorManagerN/A
    2. A complaint is automatically assigned to the Customer Service agent who initially receives it and will remain with such agent until closure or, if necessary, escalation. If escalation is required, the case will be reassigned to the agent’s supervisor.
    3. The supervisor will have an additional working day to respond and ideally, resolve the complaint before escalating it to their manager.
    4. Complaints may also be reassigned to other personnel or teams within Gumtree as appropriate (e.g., technical cases referred to the Product and Technology Teams).
    5. Once the complaint has been resolved, relevant details will be recorded, and the complaint will be closed.
  2. Subject Access Requests and Complaints of a Legal Nature
    1. Occasionally, complaints may require referral to the Legal Team for support (e.g. when a user reports illegal activity on the platform). These types of complaints are escalated directly to the Head of Customer Services and handled on a case-by-case basis.
  3. Review Process
    1. Should a Customer remain unsatisfied with the resolution of their complaint, Gumtree will consider reasonable requests to resolve disputes through alternative dispute resolution procedures, such as mediation or arbitration, as alternatives to litigation.

Title: What are features?
Summary: A brief description of each of the 5 ways to promote your ad.
Description__c:
Maybe you’re in a rush to sell, or you want to throw a spotlight on your ad? There are five different features you can buy to help boost your ad. Use them in any combination that works for you. 

Jump to the top

When you Feature your ad, it’s displayed at the top of the listings for the category you posted it in. You can choose to keep it there for three, seven or 14 days.

The Spotlight feature sends your ad to the Gumtree homepage for seven days. Everyone will see it, even if they’re not searching in the category you posted in.  

(Not every Featured and Spotlight ad can fit on the front page together. We keep it fair by rotating ads to give everyone the same visibility.)

The Bump Up feature effectively restarts your ad, as if you’d just posted it. You get your ad for another 30 days plus an express ride back to the top of the listings in your category.

Speed up your sale  

The Urgent feature puts a tag on your ad for seven days so people know you need to sell quickly.

Reach out further  

The URL feature lets you link from your ad to your own or a third party website (remember: you can’t add URLs in your ad title or description). This feature lasts for the lifetime of the ad – either 30 or 60 days, depending on the category you choose.

Title: Gumtree Recruitment Scams
Summary: A guide to fake Gumtree job scams
Description__c:
Unfortunately, fraudsters are a reality of online life, and as such we need to be more aware than ever to the elaborate methods they use to scam innocent people. We have recently seen fraudsters impersonating Gumtree and it's employees through a fake recruitment scheme. Here are some tips to help avoid this scam.

 

Receiving Job Offers at Gumtree via Social Media, SMS or Whatsapp

Gumtree will never send a job offer to any individual via social media, SMS or Whatsapp, especially in the scenario where you have not applied for a vacancy. If you receive a job offer at Gumtree, some giveaways that this is a scam include:
 

  • Being approached without having applied for a vacancy
  • Only requiring a 'smartphone' to be able to undertake the work
  • Too good to be true salaries or payments
  • Being asked to give personal details such as a contact phone number
  • Receiving instruction to visit websites to provide more information or receive further job information
  • Initial contact received from a non-UK phone number


Below we have included a screenshot of such a message to help you spot them:
 

 

Blocking the User

If you have received a fake Gumtree job offer, you should take steps to block the sender, and, if available, report it to the service provider that it was received on. 

 

Reporting to Gumtree

As with any suspect activity, we always recommend you report it to Gumtree via our Help Desk. This allows our team to investigate and take any necessary preventative measures. We can also help give advice if you are still unsure on actions that you may still need to take.

 

Jobs at Gumtree

If you are interested in working for Gumtree, you should only ever apply for vacancies advertised on our recruitment page: https://www.gumtree.com/careers.

If someone’s reluctant to play by these rules when you’re negotiating, walk away. And please, always report suspicious behaviour.

Meet face to face and tell others when and where you’re going
meet in daylight if you can. Choose somewhere busy, like your local coffee shop. If you need to meet at a house, always have a friend with you.

Never send payment for items you haven’t seen
The safest way to buy is to see and check what you’re getting before you pay for it.

If an ad or reply sounds too good to be true, it probably is
Everyone likes a bargain, but do your research and know the fair market value for the item. Ask lots of questions and request paperwork, certificates and receipts. Search your seller’s number or business online to check if they have any history or reviews.

If you want to buy an item, agree a price in advance and only take that amount. Sellers can check bank notes are genuine before accepting them with our Gumtree guide to spotting fake cash.

-       If you’re the buyer, you shouldn’t have to pay unexpected fees for brokerage or import duties
-       Confirm when you’re received the item, and expect the seller to confirm payment

Don’t use Paysafe, Ukash or Western Union for Gumtree trades
Certain payment methods give you a level of protection. But these don’t. Be suspicious of a seller who asks you to switch payment method (usually from a safer one like PayPal), claiming they have account issues. Use our guide to get familiar with paying online.

Title: Waste Removal Services Advice
Summary: Advice on what to keep in mind when considering or hiring waste removal services.
Description__c:
At Gumtree we are committed to tackling environmental concerns, and are aware that fly tipping and illegal waste disposal are becoming a growing problem. That’s why we have worked with the Environment Agency to put together this advice, to help encourage our community to make informed decisions when it comes to waste removal and help book these services responsibly. 

We’re passionate about recycling, reusing and repurposing, and driving a culture of recommerce.

Recycling or Reselling First

Before contacting a waste disposal service, think about whether you could recycle or even resell first. You can find plenty of potential buyers on Gumtree by posting an ad for your unwanted furniture, electricals or even unused building materials, and could make some cash at the same time.

Background Checks

Do some background checks on the waste removal company. These services have to carry a licence allowing them to dispose of waste, and you can search the full list of registered companies at the following websites:

England: https://environment.data.gov.uk/public-register/view/index
Scotland: https://www2.sepa.org.uk/wastecarriers/
Northern Ireland: https://www.daera-ni.gov.uk/articles/registered-waste-carriers-transporters

Waste removal services should also be able to give the name of an authorised facility they are taking the waste to for disposal. A ‘yard’ does not qualify as an authorised facility.

Too Good to be True

When getting a quote for waste disposal, always follow this simple advice; if it is too good to be true, it probably is. Services that seem underpriced or offering immediate collection could lead to fly-tipping or illegal disposal.

Your Responsibilities

Remember that it is your responsibility to correctly dispose of waste. If incorrectly disposed and traced back to you or your business, you could be liable to prosecution. You can find advice on your responsibilities here.

Don’t Forget to Check with your Council

Many councils will help with the disposal of waste. You can find plenty of guidance at this Government page, and also check to see whether your council will dispose of garden waste here.

Gumtree works closely with the Pets Advertising Advisory Group (PAAG), and as such shares the concerns raised by PAAG & other animal welfare experts regarding the significant health and welfare issues associated with exaggerated physical conformations in certain species of pet. We have therefore taken the decision to restrict listings where we believe extreme conformations are present.

 

Examples of animals where such extreme conformities exist include, but are not limited to:

 

Dogs: Pugs, French Bulldogs, English Bulldogs and other Bulldog types

 

Cats: Sphynx, Scottish Folds, Persians & Munchkins

 

Small Furries: Guinea Pigs, Hamsters, Rats, Mice & Ferrets

Title: Dealer Auction - Collections FAQs
Summary: Collections FAQ
Description__c:
Collection

Does Gumtree offer a car collection? 

Not directly, but our network of verified dealers will either arrange a collection themselves or can choose to send their representatives.

What happens when the dealer collects the car?

On the day of collection, the dealer will inspect your vehicle to ensure it matches the details and photos provided. This is typically done to verify its condition and accuracy.

Who collects the car?

The dealer or one of the dealer's representatives will be sent to collect your vehicle. They should make you aware of this when you make contact with them. 

Do I need to prepare anything for the inspection and collection?

Once you've scheduled an appointment for the collection or drop-off of your vehicle, you should have certain documents ready to facilitate the process. This includes your V5 logbook, current MOT certificate and any records of vehicle work/services. You should also make sure the car is clean and ready to be taken away. In particular, make sure you have not left anything in your vehicle.

How long does it take between my offer being accepted and the car being collected?

We expect that most vehicles will be collected within 3-7 working days.

Do I get to decide the collection date?

Yes, you will be able to agree on this with the dealer. 

Will the dealer change their offer on the collection day?

So long as you have accurately provided information about your vehicle then it is not expected that the dealer will attempt to re-negotiate the offer. However, if they discover new information (e.g. something is not described or not as described) then they may have the right to amend their offer.
 

What happens if the collection does not take place at the time it was meant to? Will I be compensated?

Contact the dealer to re-arrange a new time. Gumtree will not offer compensation.

Can I / Should I be present during the inspection and collection?

You will be able to discuss this with the dealer or person(s) collecting the vehicle. 

How do I know that the person inspecting and collecting my car is from the dealership or an appointed representative?

Between organising collection and arriving the dealer should inform you of who is collecting the vehicle. When the dealer or their representative arrives to collect your vehicle, they'll make sure to provide you with their identification. It's just a simple step to ensure everything is transparent and secure. You'll have peace of mind knowing exactly who you're dealing with.

Why do I need to show my identification?

Dealers require seller identification during the vehicle collection process for security reasons, which is quite common when it comes to buying and selling vehicles. It's just a way to ensure that you're legally entitled to sell the vehicle.

Title: Dealer Auction - General FAQ's
Summary: Dealer Auction General FAQ's
Description__c:
General

What is Dealer Auction?

To provide private car sellers with a quick and secure selling experience, Gumtree is trialling a new service called Dealer Auction, which connects private car sellers with partner car dealerships. Dealers compete in an auction and the highest offer above a seller's reserve price is shared. Offers are valid for 7 days. 

How does Dealer Auction work for private sellers?

 
  1. Opt in to receive offers for your car from dealers


When you choose to receive offers from dealers, Gumtree will email you within 24 hours (or on Monday if you list over the weekend) to collect additional information about your car to help attract more potential buyers and ensure a smoother transaction process.

 
  1. Your car enters the Dealer Auction (and as a regular private listing)
     

Once you have uploaded the additional information about your car, we notify our network of dealers across the country. They will then have the opportunity to submit their best offers for your vehicle in a daily online auction. Your car will be in the auction for 2 days.

 
  1. Receive your top offer
     

Gumtree will email you the day after the auction closes (or on Monday if the auction closes over the weekend) with the highest offer received above your reserve price, for your approval. Offers last for 7 days. You will also be provided the dealer's details to arrange a convenient collection date for your car. And the best part? It's all done free of charge.

 
  1. Finalise the sale
     

The dealer will organise an inspection upon collection and payment will be arranged. 

Who can use Dealer Auction?

Dealer Auction is designed exclusively for private individuals who want to sell their vehicles to car dealerships. 

Is Dealer Auction available nationwide?

Dealer Auction is available in England, Scotland and Wales but not Northern Ireland at this time. 

What types of vehicles can private sellers list on Dealer Auction?

Private sellers can list used cars of different makes, models, and price ranges.

Are there any requirements or inspections for vehicles listed by private sellers?

While Dealer Auction encourages sellers to provide accurate and detailed information about their vehicles, there are no specific inspection requirements for private sellers. However, providing thorough and honest descriptions of your vehicle's condition can help attract more potential buyers and ensure a smoother transaction process.

How does the payment and vehicle transfer process work for private sellers?

Gumtree will facilitate communication between the seller and dealer to arrange payment and vehicle transfer. The specific details and methods of payment are to be agreed upon by both parties involved.

Can private sellers set a reserve price for their vehicles?

Yes. Any offers made under the reserve price will be automatically rejected.

How much does it cost for sellers to use Dealer Auction?

Dealer Auction is free to sellers. Dealer Auction charges a fee to dealers for successful transactions.

Is there customer support available for private sellers?

Yes, sellers can contact customer support to assist with their experience on the platform. If you have any questions, concerns, or need assistance with the listing or auction process, you can get in contact.

Can private sellers track their auction activity and history?

Sellers will receive an email upon completing the additional vehicle information required in order for the car to enter an auction. Once a car enters the dealer auction, sellers will  receive an email within 48 hours notifying them of the highest offer or that no offers were made.

Is my information secure as a private seller on Dealer Auction?

Gumtree takes data security seriously and implements industry-standard security measures to protect your information as a private seller. Your account and personal details are encrypted and stored securely, ensuring the confidentiality of your information, and in line with our Privacy Notice.

How can sellers maximise their chances of receiving offers and selling their vehicles?

To maximise your chances of receiving offers from dealers, it is advisable to provide detailed and accurate information about your vehicle, including high-quality photos. 

How long do offers last for?

7 days from receiving your email notification of the highest bid.

What T&Cs apply?

The Dealer Auction T&Cs will apply to your use of the Dealer Auction feature.

Title: My Ad was Removed
Summary: Find out why your ad was removed, put on hold, or became inactive.
Description__c:
Other than expiring naturally, there are 3 ways that your ad can be removed from Gumtree. To check what happened to your ad, go into the Manage my Ads section. Click Inactive ads or use the Active/Inactive drop-down menu.

On Hold

An ad marked Hold means that something about the ad needs to be edited before it can be reposted. Check your email for more information on what specifically needs to be changed.

Deleted

Ads that say Deleted have been removed from the user’s end. If you or someone using your account accidentally deleted your ad, you can repost it right away by clicking Repost on that ad.

Removed

Removed means that your ad has been removed from Gumtree for a violation of our site policies. When this happens, an email will be sent to your account’s primary email explaining which policy was broken. If you can’t find the email, check your email’s junk and/or spam folders. You can review our site policies in the General Posting Policies article.

As long as you don’t continue to break any of our policies, you may repost your ad at any time. If the item, service, or job you’re posting is against our policies, we ask that you please refrain from reposting.

If you have questions about our policies or you feel that your ad was not breaking Gumtree’s policies, please contact our customer support team. We’ll be happy to look into the situation.

Title: Getting it right: Being safe on Gumtree
Summary: Gumtree policies and our guide to posting great ads.
Description__c:
Getting it Right: Being safe on Gumtree

Gumtree basics 

People can advertise thousands of things on Gumtree. But it’s not the right place for everything. Before posting, check our A-Z of items you can't buy or sell on Gumtree. If you try to advertise one of these and you’ve paid a fee for your ad, you won’t get a refund when we remove your ad.

-       Under 18? 
It’s 18 and over here please.

-       If it’s not in your possession, you can’t sell it
This includes tickets and pre-order items. Check our special guidelines for selling tickets as it can be more complex than you might imagine.

Also, you can only sell items based in the UK.

-       No duplicates please
Don’t create more than one ad for the same item, or create multiple accounts.

-       Don’t leave it live
Once your ad has done its job, delete it. If you don’t, other users might still contact you about it, which is a nuisance for them and you.

Putting everything in right place  

-       Get the category right 
Our categories work hard to connect the right ad with the right buyer. Please don’t try to get more views or avoid paying our fees by posting in the wrong one. You’ll get better results when your ad appears in the right place.

Writing a great ad 

-       Follow the ad template
Keep website links and contact details in the designated place and out of your ad title, description and photos. Don’t be tempted to spam with keywords.

-       Steer clear of disputes by writing a clear and honest description of your item. 

-       Use plain English and keep it clean. That goes for the images you post too. You’re welcome to add a translation in another language in your item description. Ads that clearly state what the item is are easier for users to find.

-       Got a job lot?
You can post multiple items in one ad if you’re selling them together. Otherwise, you’ll need to create individual ads. You may need to pay a fee, depending on what you’re advertising. 

-       The price is right
Clearly state the price you want for your item. You’re welcome to invite near offers if you want, but don’t invite bids. Gumtree isn’t an auction house.
 

Aim for face-to-face
Don’t say you’ll only send an item in the post. Gumtree is a community. We encourage our users to meet face-to-face whenever possible.

Title: Gumtree Tax Strategy
Summary: Gumtree's detailed Tax Strategy
Description__c:
In compliance with section 161 and paragraph 19(2) of schedule 19 Finance Act 2016, Gumtree.com Limited is publishing its UK tax strategy for the year ending 31 December 2020.

Our business has a strong focus on corporate responsibility, and we see responsible administration and payment of taxation as a responsibility of our business.

Our overall UK tax strategy is to:

  • Meet all legal requirements and to make all appropriate tax returns and tax payments.
  • Seek to utilise available tax reliefs and incentives only in a manner, which is consistent with the government’s policy objectives and spirit of the tax law and ensure that the tax treatment of those transactions appropriately follows the underlying commercial decision making.
  • Consider tax in the context of the business operations, its environment, its reputation and brand.
  • Comply with and maintain appropriate tax risk processes, and ensure there is appropriate Board oversight.

Risk management and governance arrangements

We want our UK tax affairs to be transparent and compliant with tax legislation, and recognize that managing tax compliance is increasingly complex. Our internal structure is set up to ensure:

  • our statutory directors understand the importance of tax compliance, and how it is achieved.
  • there is a constant dialogue between those directors and individuals tasked with the operation of our finance function, regarding the way our business manages its tax risk.
  • the business adopts and portrays a positive view towards tax compliance and the importance of meeting our obligations.

We keep under review how we meet our tax obligations, by seeking external tax advice, and through regular dialogue with HMRC.

Attitude towards risk

Compliance with our tax obligations is key to managing our tax risk. We understand the importance of tax in the wider context of business decisions and have processes in place to ensure tax is addressed appropriately as part of our decision making process. Gumtree is committed to complying with all applicable tax laws. Gumtree has a low risk appetite in relation to tax matters, assessing tax risk and making tax decisions with regards to its reputation and integrity.

Relationship with HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC)

At all times Gumtree adopts an open and collaborative professional relationship with HMRC. It engages in full, open and early dialogue with HMRC to discuss tax planning, strategy, risks and significant transactions. It makes fair, accurate and timely disclosures in correspondence and returns, and responds to queries and information requests in a timely fashion. It seeks to resolve issues with HMRC in real time and before returns are filed if possible, and where disagreements arise, work with HMRC to resolve issues.

Tax planning

We undertake appropriate tax planning as part of our overall business strategy. We do not undertake aggressive tax planning, or deploy artificial arrangements to obtain a tax advantage. We aim to minimize any tax compliance risk and the negative publicity which would flow from that. Professional advice is sought on a transactional basis, with the extent of such advice being driven by our assessment of the risk presented by each relevant transaction.

Title: Policies in Pets
Summary: Gumtree’s policies concerning the Pets category.
Description__c:
At Gumtree, we take our responsibilities towards protecting animal welfare seriously. The Pets category is to help people find good, safe, and caring homes for their pets. In order to protect animal welfare and uphold UK laws, please respect the following rules when posting an ad on Gumtree:

  • Members are allowed 2 rehoming adverts within a 12-month period. Ads exceeding this limit may be removed.
  • All pets must be advertised with a price on Gumtree. "Swapping" of Pets is also prohibited.
  • Pet Wanted ads are not permitted on Gumtree.
  • A pet is for life. As such, we do not allow the advertisement of animals as Christmas presents, Easter Presents, Valentine’s Day presents, etc.
  • We do not encourage breeding on Gumtree. Stud/breeding services are not allowed. Similarly, animals cannot be sold for the purposes of breeding or when already pregnant.
  • Litters may not be advertised before they are born. This includes hatchling eggs.
  • Puppies, kittens, and other mammals may not be sold before they are 8 weeks old. They may be advertised on Gumtree before they are 8 weeks under the condition that the ad states that they will not be rehomed until they are at least 8 weeks old.
  • All dogs over 8 weeks must be microchipped before sale.
  • From 10th June 2024, all cats over 20 weeks must be microchipped before rehoming,
  • All pet ads require a photo of the exact animal being sold. If selling a litter, each pet must be pictured in the ad, either as a group or individually. Lost/found ads are exempt from this policy.
  • Gumtree does not allow any ads that offer shipment of animals. Animals may only be sold locally so that the transactions can occur in person and the welfare of the animal can be ensured. For this same reason, meeting in a third-party location is not allowed.
  • Imported pets are not allowed. This includes rescue animals from overseas.
  • Under no circumstances may animals be sold for fighting purposes.
 

Certain types of pets are not permitted on Gumtree. As well as our list of animals that we do not allow, please do not post a pet if they fit into any of the following restrictions:

  • Dogs with docked tails, cropped/clipped ears, or tacked eyes are not allowed to be sold on Gumtree. These types of services are also not allowed. Note: Eye tacking is permitted in breeds that are prone to entropion, such as Shar Peis.
  • Cats that have been declawed or birds that have had their wings clipped are not allowed to be sold on Gumtree. These types of services are also not allowed.
  • Gumtree’s Pets category is intended for pets only. We do not allow the sale of working or hunting dogs.
  • Gumtree does not allow the sale of animals for feeder purposes (i.e., mice to be fed to snakes), whether alive or frozen.
  • Gumtree does not allow the sale of animals that require a license to own under the Dangerous Wild Animals Act.
  • For a more detailed list of which species we do not allow, read our Animals We Do Not Allow article.
 

Policies for Pet Related Items

  • Gumtree does not allow the sale of prong collars, training collars, or spray collars.
  • The sale of prescription drugs for pets is not permitted on Gumtree. This includes contraceptive drugs for pets.
  • Pet food, treats, and vitamins are not allowed to be sold on Gumtree.
  • Breeding equipment may be sold as long as it does not come with an animal.

Title: Making a Complaint
Summary: How to make a complaint to Gumtree
Description__c:
At Gumtree, we endeavour to provide our users with excellent customer service. However, we acknowledge that, at times, we may fail to meet expectations. Should you be dissatisfied with the service Gumtree has provided you, be it on platform or with resolution to an issue you have encountered, you can make a formal complaint through the following channels:
 

  • Email & Live Chat: Contact Us page (clearly stating this is a formal complaint)
  • Post: 27 Old Gloucester Street, London, WC1N 3AX
 

What to expect from us

All complaints will be acknowledged within 1 working day of receipt, upon which we will begin an immediate investigation. Please be aware that during the investigation, we may need to contact you for further information. Whilst we endeavour to resolve any issues as soon as possible, we aim to have a final position on the complaint within 7 working days of acknowledgement of the complaint.

You can find a full overview of this process on our Complaints Process page.
 

Options if you are dissatisfied with a response to a finance or Insurance related complaint

If your complaint is related to finance or Insurance and we have not been able to resolve your complaint within the above time frame, or you are dissatisfied with our final response, you have the right to refer your complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service ('FOS'). The FOS is an independent body established to settle disputes between UK-based financial companies and consumers. You are able to refer your complaint to the FOS on any of the below contact details:
 
  • Telephone: 0300 123 9 123 or 0800 023 4567
  • Email: complaint.info@financial-ombudsman.org.uk
  • Post: Exchange Tower, Harbour Exchange Square, London, E149SR
  • Complain Online: https://financial-ombudsman.org.uk/contact-us/complain-online

It is noted that complaints must be referred to the FOS within six months of receiving a final response or a summary resolution communication. You can find out more about the FOS by visiting https://financial-ombudsman.org.uk/

Title: Responsible Disclosure
Summary: If you believe that you have found a technical security vulnerability on Gumtree.com, we encourage you to let us know.
Description__c:
Responsible Disclosure Policy

At Gumtree we take user safety seriously and strive to ensure a safe experience for you when you use our websites. When properly reported, we will quickly investigate all legitimate reports of security vulnerabilities and try to fix potential problems. We have adopted this Responsible Disclosure Policy (“Policy”) to encourage reports.

We recognise the important role that security researchers and our community play in keeping gumtree.com and our customers secure. If you believe you have found a vulnerability, we would like to work with you to investigate it as quickly as possible. Please send us as much information as possible to help us better understand the nature and scope of the possible issue.

Guidelines for responsible disclosure

  • Please notify us of the site or product vulnerability without making it public.
  • Please report in a manner that safeguards confidentiality by notifying us using the guidelines below.
  • Please give us a reasonable amount of time (depending on the type of vulnerability or issue you report) to revert before making any information public regarding the vulnerability.
  • Please make a good faith effort to avoid destruction of data and interruption or degradation of our service during your research.

Once you have provided us with the information as described above, we will investigate the reported matter. As soon as we have an understanding/assessment of the vulnerability, we will determine what type of vulnerability it is.

If any vulnerability were to constitute or potentially result in a personal data breach, as defined by applicable law or regulation, we will treat such personal data breach in accordance with the requirements set forth by applicable law or regulation.

Do not engage in security research that involves:
  • Potential or actual damage to users, systems, data or applications.
  • Exploiting a vulnerability further than necessary to establish its existence.
  • Viewing other users’ data.
  • The corruption of data.
  • Conducting any activities that may disrupt our services.
  • The use of port scans on our network blocks or executing DDoS attacks.
  • Violating privacy policies, destroying data, or interrupt or otherwise degrading gumtree.com systems or the systems of its affiliates.

Reporting a security vulnerability

If you believe you have discovered a site or product vulnerability in gumtree.com, please send a report with a thorough explanation of the vulnerability by visiting our bug bounty partner via https://app.zerocopter.com/en/rd/9ccf0a6f-56c3-4c1a-aaaa-abed41e7b567. Please provide full details of the site or product vulnerability, including Proof-of-Concept URL, the details of the system where the tests were conducted and detailed reproduction steps.

IMPORTANT NOTICE: We kindly request that all reports include the CVSS score instead of using low, medium or high categorisations. Reports lacking an accurate CVSS score or with CVSS score lower than 4.0 may not meet our criteria for acceptance.

We highly appreciate your efforts and encourage you to submit high-quality reports. Thank you for your cooperation.

Security vulnerability bounty

Certain qualifying site and product vulnerabilities that are reported may lead to monetary rewards at Gumtree's sole discretion. Here is how it works:

Eligibility

To qualify for a bounty, you must:
  • Report a vulnerability that could compromise the integrity of Gumtree data.
  • Be the first person to report the vulnerability responsibly and fully (including steps to reproduce).
  • Adhere to this Policy.
  • act in good faith.

Our security team will assess each vulnerability to determine if it qualifies.

Rewards

Our security team will assess the impact, exploitability and potential risks associated with the reported vulnerability to determine an appropriate monetary reward. The determination of monetary rewards is entirely at the discretion of Gumtree.

Public disclosure of the vulnerability prior to resolution may cancel a pending reward. We reserve the right to disqualify individuals from the program for disrespectful or disruptive behaviour.

We will not negotiate the payout amount in response to duress or threats (e.g. withholding the vulnerability or threat of releasing the vulnerability or any exposed data to the public).

Exclusions

The following security vulnerabilities are NOT eligible for a bounty (and we do not recommend testing for these):
  • Denial of Service Vulnerabilities.
  • Spam, Phishing or Social Engineering techniques.
  • Brute force password cracking.
  • Use of outdated software/library versions.
  • "Advisory" or "Informational" reports that do not include any gumtree-specific testing or context.
  • CVE-2021-44228.
  • Vulnernabilities  known to the production environment.
  • Domains other than gumtree.com.

What can you expect from us?
 
  • You can expect us to respond on your message within 3 business days.
 
  • We will not pass on your personal details to third parties without your permission unless it is necessary to comply with applicable laws or regulations, or an order of any court of regulatory, judicial, governmental or similar body. You may report under a pseudonym or anonymously.
 
  • We will keep you informed of the progress while resolving the issue.
 
  • In the public information concerning the reported problem, we will give your name as the discoverer of the problem (unless you desire otherwise).
 
  • We will handle your report with strict confidentiality and not pass on your personal details to third parties without permission.
 
  • If you do not adhere to this Policy, we reserve the right to take appropriate legal measures and/or get law enforcement involved.


Governing law

Title: Online Survey Jobs
Summary: Is It Safe to Use Online Survey Sites?
Description__c:
If you've ever been seeking ways to make some extra money online, there is a chance you've read about taking paid online surveys. These surveys are provided by many different websites, and promise cash and other rewards in return for completing surveys. Whilst many of these websites are legitimate, as companies use them to conduct market research, some can be suspicious. This guide provides information on the red flags to look out for if replying to online survey ads on Gumtree.


Red Flags to look out for when taking online surveys

Promises of large payouts
Be wary of online survey website that claim to offer large payouts. Promises of large payouts are normally a trick to lure people in, and whilst a small amount of money can be made from completing online surveys, no one is going to get rich from taking surveys! Always remember that if it sounds too good to be true, it probably is.

Being asked for private or confidential information
Whilst you will be asked to provide a certain level of personal information to complete online surveys, if you are being asked to provide private or confidential information, it is likely a scam. You should never provide information such as your address, passport, driving licence or national insurance number. You should also be extremely careful if providing bank information.

Paying Fees
You should never have to pay fees to complete online surveys. Requests for upfront fees are an indicator of a scam.

Lack of information
Do your research and due diligence when signing up for online surveys. Reputable survey websites will have clear and concise information about the business, who they work with, and how you will be rewarded. If you cannot find information about the website that is clear and easily understandable, then it is best avoided.

Take precautions when taking paid surveys

Check for reviews
Check reputable review websites, such as Trustpilot or Google, for reviews of the online survey website. You will not be the first person to have used the website, so if you cannot find reviews or ratings, this should be a warning sign.

Do not hand over too much personal information
Pay close attention to the information you are handing over to a survey website, and trust your instincts. If you are being asked to hand over confidential or private information, treat this as a warning sign and simply leave the website.

Make sure the site is not displaying get quick rich tactics
Survey websites that make outlandish claims, or use bold language and images, should be treated as suspicious. Remember that completing online surveys is not going to make you rich.


If ever you feel suspicious about an advert on Gumtree, always remember that you can simply walk away. The best advice we can give our users is that if an offer seems too good to be true, it probably is.

Title: Posting Policies
Summary: Learn about Gumtree's rules for posting ads.
Description__c:
At Gumtree we want to make sure that the site is as clean, friendly and usable as possible for everyone. Ads that fall outside the posting rules stated in our Help sections or our Terms of Use may be removed from the site.

You are solely responsible for all information that you submit to Gumtree and any consequences that may result from your post. We reserve the right at our discretion to refuse or delete content that we believe is inappropriate or breaching our Terms of Use. We also reserve the right at our discretion to restrict a user's usage of the site either temporarily or permanently, or to refuse a user's registration.

Please take the following policies into account before posting:

  • All Gumtree ads must be posted by members over 16 years of age.
  • Malicious, defaming or slanderous ads are not permitted on the site.
  • Illegal items or services are not permitted on Gumtree.
  • Ad that contains adult, mature or erotic content are not allowed.
  • Personals are not allowed.
  • All ads must be posted in the most appropriate category.
  • Each item, job or service should only be posted on the site once. Duplicates and spam ads are not allowed.
  • Each ad must only contain one item. Multiple items must be listed in individual ads, with the exception of household clearance ads and job ads with multiple openings for the same position.
  • Items posted for sale must include the price within the ad.
  • URLs must be entered in the URL field, not in the description of the ad.
  • Members must enter their contact details in the correct fields within their ads. Revealing these details in the ad description, photos or title is not allowed.
  • Premium phone numbers are not permitted to be used in the Contact Phone Number field, or in the ad description. They can be used in the Registered Phone Number field.
  • Adding fake or invalid phone numbers is not allowed. Including a phone number in your ad is optional. If you don’t want to include one, leave the field blank.
  • Keyword spamming (including many irrelevant words within your ad) to manipulate searches is not allowed.
  • Gumtree does not allow discrimination of any kind.
  • Offensive language, hate speech or extreme profanity are not allowed.
  • Auctions ads are not permitted on Gumtree.
  • Sold items and other ads that are no longer available should be deleted by the poster.
  • All items and services must be based in the UK, unless advertising an overseas property, in which case it must be posted in the International Property category.
  • Ads stating that they will not accept cash are not permitted.
  • Ads stating that the item is not able to be inspected or picked up in person are not allowed.
  • Pre-order ads are not allowed. All items must be in the possession of the seller before they can be posted.
  • All ads must be posted in English. Having a translation in another language is permitted.
  • We retain the right to remove any listings, regardless of category, that contains inaccuracies, falsehoods or misleading information, or exploits vulnerable users.

Title: Why Wasn’t My Ad Bumped Up?
Summary: Learn about common issues and misunderstandings with the Bump Up feature.
Description__c:
After paying for your Bump Up, it will take effect right away. Remember that Bump Ups are a one-time renewal of your ad’s rank. As new ads are posted or bumped up, your ad will be pushed down again, just like it was when it was new. In busier categories or locations, this can happen quickly.

While your ad may be pushed off the front page in wider searches, it will still be higher in the rankings then it was before. In more detailed searches, it will stay near the top longer.

How to Check Quickly

To check if your Bump Up was applied, look at the Posted date on your ad’s page. If it shows the date you applied the Bump Up instead of the date you originally posted it, then your Bump Up has worked correctly.

If I Can’t See It on the First Page, How Will Anyone Else?

Most users don’t search entire categories at a time, which is what sellers tend to do when looking for their own ads. When actually searching for items, users usually enter keywords, specific subcategories and locations, and add filters. This narrows the number of ads down, which means that your ad will be on their first page for far longer than it will be in the general category.

Title: Fixing Browser Issues
Summary: Learn about common issues caused by browsers and how to correct them.
Description__c:
Internet browsers are the gateways we use to interact with websites. If part of the gateway isn’t working properly, it can cause issues with many parts of a website. Some common problems caused by browser issues are:

  • Buttons not working

  • Parts of the page missing or appearing differently

  • Information not saving after entering it on the page

If you’re experiencing a new technical issue with Gumtree, the first thing to check is your browser.

 

Recommended Desktop Browsers

We always recommend using Google Chrome for the best experience with Gumtree.

  • Google Chrome: Latest two versions

  • Mozilla Firefox: Latest two versions

Note: Whilst Gumtree will work on Internet Explorer and Microsoft Edge, we do not actively support these browsers.

 

Recommended Mobile Browsers

For the best experience on mobile, we recommend downloading the latest app from either the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.

  • Android: most recent two versions of Google Chrome

  • iOS: Latest two versions of Safari or Google Chrome

 

Checking Your Browser Settings

There are a number of parts within a browser that need to be up to date in order for a website to work. To quickly check your browser’s most important settings, visit whatismybrowser.com. Along with letting you know if your browser is up to date, the website will also give you information about settings such as cookies and JavaScript.

 

Still having trouble?

Try clearing your cookies and cache.
