Title: Masked Email Addresses
Summary: Learn about how Gumtree masks your email when using our messaging system to keep you safe.
Description__c:
Gumtree automatically masks the email addresses of buyers and sellers when replying through the site. This helps to protect you from receiving unwanted spam or fraudulent replies.

Masked emails won’t interfere with your ability to communicate on Gumtree. You will still receive email replies and you can still reply to members from your own mailbox in the normal way. To learn more about messages, read our Sending & Receiving Messages article.

How It Works

When someone replies to an ad, instead of displaying that person’s actual email address, we simply replace it with a unique Gumtree email address. We’ll also include a brief explanation so that the recipient understands why the email address has been masked.

Here is an example of what our masked emails look like:

Buyer-n734wzfpd7z3b@reply.gumtree.com

How Do I Reply?

If you receive an email from Gumtree with a masked email address, you can reply to the person from your Messages section or personal email mailbox as you normally would. This will show the "mail to" address as the masked Gumtree email address. This email address is unique and will enable us to route your reply directly back to the person who emailed you.

Masking Exceptions

When you reply to ads in the Jobs category or ads posted by business users, your email address will not be masked. You will also be able to see the business' email. This is to allow businesses to properly qualify their clientele. Unmasked emails will only be sent to business users who have registered with our sales teams, and ads posted in Jobs. All other ads will have masked emails.

Note:

  • For your safety, we recommend you only use the masked email address when replying to emails unless the ad has been posted by a business. If someone asks you to reply to a personal email address instead of their masked Gumtree email, be cautious. For more safety tips, read our Safety in Messages article.
  • Forwarding and cc’ing other email addresses in your replies may cause interruptions in service.

Title: Features for Job Ads
Summary: Learn about how to get the most out of your ad by applying Features.
Description__c:
Applying a feature is the best way to get more eyes on your ad and more applications in your inbox. We have 5 types of features available for Job ads:

Top Job

A Top Job places a copy of your ad into the rotating ads at the very top of your ad’s sector. This helps job seekers see your ad before the competition. Top Jobs can be applied to your ad for 3, 7, or 14 days.

Urgent

The Urgent feature adds a red banner to your ad that says ‘Urgent’. This helps to draw the eye and lets applicants know that you’re serious about finding the best person for the job! The Urgent feature can be applied for 7 days at a time, at which point it can be reapplied if needed.

Premium

The Premium feature applies a Premium Job label to the corner of your ad. It also highlights your ad with an eye-catching colour to make it jump off the page. The Premium feature runs for the entire 60-day run of your ad.

Website Links

The Website Link feature allows you to add a link to your website directly into your ad so that job seekers can get a feel for your company or apply directly through your site. The link will remain on your ad for its entire 60-day runtime.

Logo in the Search Results

Uploading a logo to your ad is free, but it will only appear after a job seeker opens your ad. Including your logo in the search results will give your ad a polished, professional look that will help it stand out in the queues. The logo will remain on your ad for its entire 60-day runtime.

 

How to Apply a Feature

Features can be applied when you post your ad, or after. To apply a feature when posting:

  1. Click Post a job ad.
  2. Select Pricing in the top bar to check our special deals. If you see one you like, click Get Started to begin posting an ad with that package.
  3. At the bottom of the ad creation page, you’ll see a section titled “Help your job ad stand out from the crowd”. To add more features, click the checkbox to the side of the feature you want to apply. Note: If you’re applying a Top Job, click the drop-down menu first and choose how long you’d like the feature applied to your ad. You can choose between 3, 7 or 14 days.

Once you’ve added your features to your cart, they will go live along with your ad.

Title: GDPR
Summary: Learn about our GDPR policies and how we'll protect your personal information.
Description__c:
General

1. What internal steps have you taken across your platforms to support GDPR requirements?

We have taken the following steps around our platforms to support GDPR:

  • Analyzed, map and report Personal Information throughout its lifecycle with us, that means from the time we collect it through its destruction.
  • Designed intake channels to allow users to exercise their rights in due time, such as access , modify and delete their Personal Information.
  • Implemented process to fulfil users rights, such as access, modification and deletion within one month.
  • Re-designed our registration process and privacy consent experience in our products.
  • Rolled-out Privacy-by-Design training to teams to incorporate privacy minimization concepts in their engineering processes.

2. What external steps will you be requiring from users once GDPR requirements are live?

The most visible change users will experience in the future is more granular options when it comes to obtaining their consent for marketing purposes as well as data sharing with third parties for marketing and advertising purposes.

3. How have/will you determine Consent? What data will fall under your requests for Consent? Will you be considering/applying any exceptions?

We have performed a group wide analysis of where and for which purpose we collect and use Personal Information, and especially what the legal basis is for each and every processing activity. In the future we will not gather general consent from our users by simply accepting our new User Privacy Notice. We will rather collect users’ consent for all use cases where we rely on consent to process or use your PI. For all cases, that we rely on legitimate interest, we conducted a balancing test to ensure our user’s interests, rights and freedoms did not outweigh ours.

4. What information and to whom does Gumtree disclose personal information?

We may disclose Personal Information of users to other members of the our corporate family and to third parties. This disclosure may be required for us to provide users access to our services, to comply with our legal obligations, to enforce our User Agreement, to facilitate our marketing and advertising activities, or to prevent, detect, mitigate, and investigate fraudulent or illegal activities related to our services. We do not disclose users’ Personal Information to third parties for their marketing and advertising purposes without users’ consent. To read more about the Personal Information Gumtree discloses, please visit our User Privacy Notice.

5. Are there any areas where you will qualify for Article 30, Paragraph 5 Exemption?

According to Article 30 GDPR, we have compiled a group wide register of data processing activities. We do not assume that there are any areas within our corporate family which qualifies for the Article 30, Paragraph 5 Exemption.

Additional FAQs for each GDPR implementation workstream

1. Data Discovery and Mapping

  • How does Gumtree know what Personal Information it has about its users?

    We have analyzed and mapped Personal Information throughout its lifecycle with us, that means from the time we collect it through destruction.

  • Does Gumtree share my information with third parties?

    We may disclose Personal Information of users to other members of our corporate family and to third parties. This disclosure may be required for us to provide users access to our services, to comply with our legal obligations, to enforce our User Agreement, to facilitate our marketing and advertising activities, or to prevent, detect, mitigate, and investigate fraudulent or illegal activities related to our services. We do not disclose users’ Personal Information to third parties for their marketing and advertising purposes without users’ consent. To read more about the Personal Information Gumtree discloses, please visit our User Privacy Notice.

2. Data Subject Rights

  • What are the types of Personal Information that Gumtree collects about its users? OR Tell me what information Gumtree has about me?

    Personal Information is information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person. An identifiable natural person is one who can be identified, directly or indirectly, by reference to an identifier such as a name, an identification number, location data, an online identifier, or to one or more factors specific to the physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural or social identity of that natural person.

    We do not consider personal information to include information that has been anonymized or aggregated so that it can no longer be used to identify a specific natural person, whether in combination with other information or otherwise.

    We collect personal information from you when you use our Services. To read more about what Personal Information Gumtree collects, please visit our User Privacy Notice.

  • How does a user get copies of their Personal Information?

    In most cases, users may locate the Personal Information we have about them by viewing their account profile under their account. If they do not find the data they are looking for, or are looking to submit a formal access request as defined under GDPR, users may contact the customer service team.

  • How does a user correct their personal data?

    We take steps to ensure that the Personal Information we collect from users is accurate and up to date, and that users have the ability to access and make corrections to it. Users may edit their Personal Information on their account. If they would like to request any additional corrections, users may contact the customer service team.

  • How long does it take for Gumtree to complete a users’ privacy request?

    We make every effort to complete a users’ request as quickly as possible and at the latest within one month of receipt. For some requests, the response timeframe may be extended by an additional two months where requests are complex or numerous. We will contact our users within one month of their request to inform you of any timeframe extensions.

  • How does a user submit a privacy complaint?

    In case a user has a privacy complaint, they can submit a complaint online by contacting our Customer Support Team.

  • How does a user submit a data deletion request?

    In case a user has a data deletion request, they can contact the Customer Support Team to submit a formal data deletion request as defined under GDPR. Their account will also be closed as part of fulfilling the data deletion request.

  • Will Gumtree delete users’ Personal Information after a period of inactivity?

    Yes, after a period of inactivity we will close the respective users’ account and delete his/her Personal Information based on its retention schedule.

  • Can a user submit a request on behalf of an incapacitated or deceased family member?

    Yes, a user may submit a request on behalf of an incapacitated or deceased family member, however, the user will be required to provide proof that he/she has the authority to act on their behalf.

3. Data Retention

  • How long does Gumtree retain users’ Personal Information?

    We retain users’ Personal Information for as long as necessary to provide the Services they have requested, or for other essential purposes such as complying with our legal obligations, resolving disputes, and enforcing our policies.

  • What happens to users’ Personal Information once it is no longer needed?

    After it is no longer necessary for us to retain users’ Personal Information, we will dispose it in a secure manner according to our information security, data retention and deletion policies.

4. Legal Basis of Processing

  • How does Gumtree determine that all of the Personal Information they have about their users was collected and is being processed legally?

    We have performed an analysis of where we collect and use Personal Information, and what controls exist to make sure that it is being processed appropriately and legally, in line with our User Privacy Notice.

  • How can a user determine what legal basis Gumtree is processing his/her Personal Information under?

    Our User Privacy Notice gives an overview of the ways that we use users’ Personal Information and the associated legal basis.

  • What can a user do if he/she wants to object to his/her data being processed?

    If a user objects to his/her Personal Information being processed, he/she can contact Customer Service and request that we cease processing the respective Personal Information as described in the User Privacy Notice.

5. Privacy Operations

  • How does Gumtree consider privacy of Personal Information when it is developing new products or services?

    We incorporate an assessment of privacy risks into our processes for developing new products or services that will collect, use or otherwise process Personal Information. Our privacy risk assessment process takes into account the complexity of the project and the sensitivity of the personal information being used and recommends controls to reduce risks to personal information being misused.

  • How does Gumtree train its employees in privacy?

    We provide training to employees with access to Personal Information utilizing industry leading training modules, consistent with industry norms.

6. Crisis Management / Breach Response

  • How does Gumtree determine whether a security incident has occurred?

    We have a dedicated global team to monitor our platforms. When this team receives information that could represent an incident, an analysis is performed to validate that an incident has occurred. If Personal Information is involved in an incident, our process incorporates further analysis to determine potential impact on rights and freedoms of individuals.

  • How does Gumtree determine when to notify affected individuals about a security incident?

    We incorporate notification requirements for all jurisdictions in which we operate. As data protection laws are updated, we monitor their changes to ensure that we meet our legal obligations. In addition, we review data security issues for their potential of harm to determine if we should proactively notify individuals, even when notice is not legally required.

7. Privacy Control Environment

  • How does Gumtree make sure that they have appropriate controls on personal data throughout its lifecycle?

    We have developed and implemented a control framework based on industry standards that comprises controls at every stage of the data lifecycle, from before we collect Personal Information through to when it is deleted or otherwise transformed. This control framework was reviewed and enhanced during 2017 to take into account changes in internal processes and external requirements.

  • How does Gumtree make sure that they are complying with the requirements stated in their external User Privacy Notice as well as, their internal Privacy Policy?

    Our updated Privacy Controls framework maps our external User Privacy Notice, as well as our internal Privacy Policy to requirements of GDPR. Our team has been testing against the requirements of these policies for several years and are expanding their work to include validation of new controls implemented for GDPR throughout the data lifecycle.

Users have the ability to edit their Personal Information on their account. If they would like to request any additional corrections, users may contact the customer service team.

·         How long does it take for eBay to complete a users’ privacy request?
We make every effort to complete a users’ request as quickly as possible and at the latest within one month of receipt. For some requests, the response timeframe may be extended by an additional two months where requests are complex or numerous. We will contact our users within one month of their request to inform you of any timeframe extensions.

·         How does a user submit a privacy complaint?
In case a user has a privacy complaint, they can reach the Global Privacy Office in writing to: eBay Inc, Attn: Legal - Global Privacy Office, 2065 Hamilton Avenue, San Jose, California 95125, USA. Users can also submit a complaint online at our eBay Privacy Center.

·         How does a user submit a data deletion request?
In case a user has a data deletion request, they can contact the customer service team to submit a formal data deletion request as defined under GDPR. Their account will also be closed as part of fulfilling the data deletion request.  

·         Will eBay delete users’ Personal Information after a period of inactivity?
Yes, after a period of inactivity we will close the respective users’ account and delete his/her Personal Information based on its retention schedule.

·         Can a user submit a request on behalf of an incapacitated or deceased family member?
Yes, a user may submit a request on behalf of an incapacitated or deceased family member, however, the user will be required to provide proof that he/she has the authority to act on their behalf.

 
3.            Data Retention

·         How long does eBay retain users’ Personal Information?
We retain users’ Personal Information for as long as necessary to provide the Services they have requested, or for other essential purposes such as complying with our legal obligations, resolving disputes, and enforcing our policies.

·         What happens to users’ Personal Information once it is no longer needed?
After it is no longer necessary for us to retain users’ Personal Information, we will dispose it in a secure manner according to our information security, data retention and deletion policies.

 
4.            Legal Basis of Processing

·         How does eBay determine that all of the Personal Information they have about their users was collected and is being processed legally?
We have performed an analysis of where we collect and use Personal Information, and what controls exist to make sure that it is being processed appropriately and legally, in line with our User Privacy Notice.

·         How can a user determine what legal basis eBay is processing his/her Personal
Information under?
Our User Privacy Notice gives an overview of the ways that we use users’ Personal Information and the associated legal basis.

·         What can a user do if he/she wants to object to his/her data being processed?
If a user objects to his/her Personal Information being processed, he/she can contact Customer Service and request that we cease processing the respective Personal Information as described in the User Privacy Notice.
 

5.            Privacy Operations
 
·         How does eBay consider privacy of Personal Information when it is developing new products or services?
We incorporate an assessment of privacy risks into our processes for developing new products or services that will collect, use or otherwise process Personal Information. Our privacy risk assessment process takes into account the complexity of the project and the sensitivity of the personal information being used and recommends controls to reduce risks to personal information being misused.

·         How does eBay train its employees in privacy?
We provide training to employees with access to Personal Information utilizing industry leading training modules, consistent with industry norms.

 
6.            Crisis Management / Breach Response

·         How does eBay determine whether a security incident has occurred?
We have a dedicated global team to monitor our platforms. When this team receives information that could represent an incident, an analysis is performed to validate that an incident has occurred. If Personal Information is involved in an incident, our process incorporates further analysis to determine potential impact on rights and freedoms of individuals.

·         How does eBay determine when to notify affected individuals about a security incident?
We incorporate notification requirements for all jurisdictions in which we operate.  As data protection laws are updated, we monitor their changes to ensure that we meet our legal obligations.  In addition, we review data security issues for their potential of harm to determine if we should proactively notify individuals, even when notice is not legally required.
 
7.            Privacy Control Environment

·         How does eBay make sure that they have appropriate controls on personal data throughout its lifecycle?
We have developed and implemented a control framework based on industry standards that comprises controls at every stage of the data lifecycle, from before we collect Personal Information through to when it is deleted or otherwise transformed. This control framework was reviewed and enhanced during 2017 to take into account changes in internal processes and external requirements.
 
·         How does eBay make sure that they are complying with the requirements stated in their external User Privacy Notice, their internal Privacy Policy as well as their Binding Corporate Rules?  
Our updated Privacy Controls framework maps our external User Privacy Notice, our internal Privacy Policy as well as to our Binding Corporate Rules (BCRs) to requirements of GDPR. Our team has been testing against our BCR requirements for several years and are expanding their work to include validation of new controls implemented for GDPR throughout the data lifecycle. In accordance with our lead data protection authority in Europe (LDA Brandenburg/Germany), our BCRs will be updated to reflect the changes we made to the Global Privacy Program since our BCRs came into force in 2009.

Title: Reply Code of Conduct
Summary: Learn about our reply policies and how to maintain positive experiences in Gumtree messages.
Description__c:
We reserve the right to delete or ban those who we deem to be using replies inappropriately.

When contacting other users:

  • Please treat all other users with courtesy and respect.
  • Do not reply to ads with unsolicited opinions, comments, or judgements about the content of the ads, the price of the item, or the poster themselves.
  • Abusive replies are not allowed. Any replies containing hate speech or defamation are strictly prohibited.
  • All replies to ads must be about what the ad is offering. Replies containing other commercial offers are not allowed on Gumtree.
  • Impersonating other users, including supplying fake phone numbers, is not permitted. Those who are found to be doing so may lose the ability to use Gumtree.
  • Gumtree reserves the right to revoke the ability of any user to reply to ads without notice.

Receiving Inappropriate Replies

If you receive a reply that you feel is inappropriate, please do not reply. If you are using our website, you can report the reply directly to our team to investigate by using the report reply function, which can be found under the 'More Options' drop down in the bottom right of the message screen. In this menu you will also find the ability to block the other user.

You can also review other members of the Gumtree community using our rating and review system.

If a reply is threatening or abusive, or if you think you are being scammed, you should always speak directly to our support team.

Title: Where is the work wanted section?
Summary: Learn about the exciting new changes to our Jobs category.
Description__c: We have made some exciting changes to the Jobs category, relaunching as Jobs from Gumtree Unfortunately, this means that we have closed our Work Wanted category and replaced it with a new CV library. Please visit the new section to upload your CV and let us know if you require any further assistance.

Title: Bump Up Feature
Summary: Learn how a Bump Up feature can help you to get more views on your ads.
Description__c:
Sometimes an old ad just needs a bit of a boost to get the attention it deserves. The Bump Up feature is a one-time refresh of old ads, making them appear new. It pushes your ad from its current position (for example, page 5) back to the first page. Being on the top page means that your ad will gain better exposure in its category and searches.

Your ad will remain at the top until another Gumtree ad is posted or bumped up. As new ads are posted, it will begin to shift down. Due to this constant rotation of ads, a Bump Up won’t keep your ad on the front page indefinitely. But, in searches that use keywords or specific areas and categories, the effects of a Bump Up can last for a significant length of time.

Note:

  • The Bump Up feature will reset the post date of your ad; however, it won't extend the life of your ad. For more information on ad lifespans, please read our How Long Are Ads Active article.
  • If you want your ad to stay at the top for a longer period of time, consider the Featured promotion.

Ready to promote your ad? Read our step-by-step guide on how to promote your ad.

Title: I Can't Find My Spotlight Ad
Summary: Learn how a Spotlight feature can help your ad get more views.
Description__c:
The Spotlight feature brings a copy of your ad into the Homepage. Each time the Homepage is refreshed or opened by a new member, a new set of Spotlight ads are loaded.

In busier areas, there are more likely to be a larger number of Spotlight ads in rotation. This means that you may have to refresh the Homepage a number of times before you see it. Remember that busier areas also mean more buyers will be looking at the Spotlight ads.

When you apply a Spotlight promotion, it creates a second version that will appear in the Spotlight section. The original version of your ad will continue to move throughout the search results at the same time.

If I Have to Refresh to See It, How Will Anyone Else See It?

In one word – volume. Every user that visits the Homepage will see a random selection of Spotlight ads from the location selected in their search bar. You may not see it right away, but many other users will.

The Spotlight is especially beneficial because it isn’t specified by category. This means that people who might not even know they wanted your item will see it and decide to buy.

Title: Spotlight Feature
Summary: Learn how a Spotlight feature can help your ad get more views.
Description__c:
Get ahead of the game by putting your ad in front of buyers before they even look for it. Our Spotlight feature places a copy of your ad onto the homepage so that users will see it as soon as they visit Gumtree. At the same time, the original copy of your ad will continue to move through the regular search results. This allows your ad to get all of the same views it would regularly, while also appearing outside of its category to local viewers.

The Spotlight feature gives your ad the opportunity to appear on the Gumtree homepage for 7 days. It is available for purchase on desktop and the app (where it’s called the Homepage Gallery feature); however, Spotlight ads are not viewable from within the app.

How the Spotlight Section Works

Spotlight ads rotate randomly to ensure that every ad gets equal visibility. The Gumtree homepage displays up to 8 Spotlight ads at a time. If there are more than 8 Spotlight ads within an area, a random selection of 8 will be chosen each time the page is loaded. This means that each user will see different ads on the homepage.

Note:

  • Your ad must have at least one photo in order to use the Spotlight feature.
  • This feature does not change the position of your ad in the regular search results.

Ready to promote your ad? Read our step-by-step guide on how to promote your ad.

Title: Urgent Feature
Summary: Learn how adding an Urgent label can help your ad get more views.
Description__c:
In this day and age, most of us are busy. You’ve got family to look out for, work to do, and that new Netflix show to watch. Our Urgent feature lets other users know that you’re not looking to waste time. It places the word ‘Urgent’ on your ad in eye-catching, red lettering. Not only will it stand out in the queues, but other users will know that you’re serious about selling your item, renting your property, or filling that job opening fast.

The Urgent label runs for 7 days from the date and time of purchase. During those 7 days, the Urgent label can be seen when your ad appears in the search results. There’s also a filter option to let users search exclusively for Urgent ads.

Note:

  • This feature is intended to help your ad stand out. It does not change the position of your ad in the general listings.

Ready to promote your ad? Read our step-by-step guide on how to promote your ad.

Title: Featured Ads
Summary: Learn how the Featured promotion can help your ad get more views.
Description__c:
Get the most out of Gumtree by placing your ad ahead of the pack. Our Featured promotion helps you get more views by placing your ad at the top of the search results. The first 5 spots at the top of every page are reserved for Featured ads.

Featured ads can run for 3, 7, or 14 days. During that length of time, your ad will start to appear in two places. It will still continue to move through the regular listings, but a second copy will also appear in the Featured ads section. Displaying your ad in these two sections at the same time gives it a much better chance of exposure.

How the Featured Ad Section Works

Featured ads rotate randomly to ensure that every ad gets equal visibility. Each page of search results shows up to 5 Featured ads at a time. If there are more than 5 Featured ads in the search results, a random set of 5 will be shown. Every user that visits that same page will see a different random set. When they refresh the page or move to another search page, the ads will once again be shuffled. This random rotation ensures that all Featured ads get equal opportunities to appear at the top of the first page.

Note:

  • Only the copy of your ad that appears in the Featured ad section will display the Featured banner. The copy moving through the regular search results will not have the Featured banner.
  • This feature does not change the position of your ad outside of the Featured ads section.

Ready to promote your ad? Read our step-by-step guide on how to promote your ad.

Title: URL Feature
Summary: Learn how to add a URL to your ad in order to drive viewers to your website.
Description__c:
Whether they’re looking to buy an item or hire your business, buyers want all the information they can get. The URL feature is the best way to direct people to additional information without copying all that information into your ad. When you apply the URL feature, it places a clickable link (hyperlink) in the seller profile section, just below the Email button. Interested users can click on the link to be taken directly to a website of your choice.

The link will appear for the lifetime of the ad – either 30 or 60 days, depending on the category you choose. If the ad is renewed, a new URL feature must be repurchased for the link to continue to appear on your ad.

Note:

  • This feature is available on desktop only.
  • All ads on Gumtree should be offering an item, service, or job through Gumtree. Ads that only direct traffic to an alternate website are against our site policies.
  • URLs must be placed within the URL feature field. Please do not place your URL within the title or body of your ad, as this is against Gumtree policies.

Ready to include a URL in your ad? Read our step-by-step guide on how to promote your ad.

Title: How to Promote an Ad
Summary: Learn how to apply features to your ads to get more views and move your ad higher in the listings.
Description__c:
There are several ways to boost your ad to drive more views and replies. There are 5 unique feature options to chose from.

To promote an existing ad:

  1. Login to your account and click on the user menu  at the top of the page.
  2. Select Manage My Ads.
  3. Find the ad you’d like to promote and click Promote.
  4. A drop-down will appear with the 4 promotion options. Click View example to learn more about each option.
  5. When you’ve chosen the promotion you want, click the checkbox next to it. If you’re applying a Featured ad promotion, you can choose a run-time for the promotion using the feature drop-down menu.
  6. When you’re happy with your selection, click Continue.

To promote a new ad:

  1. Click Post an Ad, then fill in your ad details. For help creating your ad, read our How to Post an Ad article.
  2. In the section titled 'Make your ad stand out', you’ll see 4 promotion options. Click View example to learn more about each option.
  3. When you’ve chosen the promotion you want, click the checkbox next to it. If you’re applying a Featured ad promotion, you can choose a run-time for the promotion using the feature drop-down menu.
  4. When you’re happy with your selection, click Post My Ad.

Paying for Your Promotion

  1. Once in the payment screen, you will see the total price at the top. Make sure to review it before continuing with payment.
  2. You can choose to pay by credit card (VISA, Mastercard or Maestro) or PayPal. It defaults to credit card, but you can switch to PayPal by clicking the PayPal tab.
  3. If you’re paying through credit card, enter your card details and click Pay Now. If you’re paying through PayPal, click Pay with PayPal and follow the instructions.

Once your payment is processed, your features will activate.

Title: How to Edit an Ad
Summary: Learn how to change the details of an active ad, as well as which parts of an ad can’t be edited.
Description__c:
Editing an ad follows the almost exactly the same steps as posting an ad. To edit:

  1. Make sure you’re logged into your account, then click on the user menu  at the top of the page.
  2. Select Manage My Ads.
  3. Find the ad you want to edit in the list of your active ads.
  4. Click Edit  next to that ad.
  5. Any sections of the page that do not have a lock beside it can be edited. Find the section you want to change and add/remove information as needed.
  6. If editing photos, click the delete  button in the corner of an image to delete it. If you want to rearrange the photos, you will need to delete and re-add the photos in the order you want them to appear.
  7. When you’re ready to post the changes, click Update My Ad.

Note: Editing an ad may cause it to be put back through our systems to be processed again. If it's taking a little longer than expected, please bear with us.

What Can’t Be Edited

There are 4 parts of an ad that cannot be edited once it has been posted on the site. Here’s how to deal with each of those sections:

Category

The type of information we request changes in each category. Due to this, it can’t be altered after an ad is created. If you’ve posted in the incorrect category, you will need to delete and repost your ad.

Private vs. Business

If you’ve accidentally posted as a Business instead of a Private seller, or vice versa, you will need to delete and repost the ad.

Location

Once an ad has been posted, it’s locked into that location. If you need to change it after posting, you’ll need delete and repost the ad.

Poster’s Email

If you need to change the email that is linked to your ad, you will need to change the email linked to your entire account. For instructions, read our Changing Your Account Email article. If the email you want to use is already linked to another account, you will need to delete the ad and repost it after logging into the correct account. There is no way to move an ad from one Gumtree account to another without reposting.

Unable to Edit Price and Other Editing Issues

If you’re having trouble editing a section of your ad not mentioned in the list above, it may be due to the information that you’re trying to enter. Make sure that you're not using any special characters like emojis or symbols. In number-specific fields like price, length, and kilometres, please only enter numbers, not letters. If you're still having trouble try clearing your cookies and cache before trying again.

Title: How to change your email address
Summary: Learn how to change the email linked to your Gumtree account.
Description__c:
Changing your contact email will change the email through which you receive messages, notifications, and marketing materials for Gumtree. The email address you use to login will always remain the same as the email you used to register. There is no way to change the login email linked to your account.

To change the contact email for your Gumtree account, please follow the steps below:

  1. Login to the Gumtree account you want to edit.
  2. Click on the user menu (after logging in, it will say "Hello" with your user name).
  3. Select My Details from the drop-down list.
  4. Within the Contact Details section, click Edit.
  5. Enter your new email in the empty field under the "Your primary email" heading. Click Change Primary.
  6. An email will be sent to your new email address. If you don’t see the email within 10 minutes, check your spam/junk folders. Once you’ve received the email, click the link within the email to confirm the change.

The change will be made as soon as your email is confirmed. If you don’t see it change right away, try refreshing the page.

Title: Issues with the Gumtree App

Title: Posting Ads on the Android App
Summary: Learn how to create ads using the Gumtree app for Android.
Description__c:
Follow the steps below to have your ad up and running in no time.

Getting Started

  1. On the Gumtree Home screen, tap the Post an Ad button (it looks like a camera) at the bottom of the screen.
  2. If you have a draft ad started, you can choose to continue creating it, or start a new ad.
  3. Add images by selecting the Add a Photo button located at the top of the screen. Choose up to 10 photos from your phone’s gallery or take new ones. You can also change the order in which they’re displayed by clicking and dragging them into the correct order. When you’re happy with your photos, tap Done and then tap Done again to continue creating your ad.
  4. Enter your title, description, and price by tapping into that section of the screen and entering your information.
  5. To select your category, tap on Category. Some suggestions will appear based on the title of your ad. If none of the suggestions are correct, scroll down and select a category manually.
  6. Depending on the category you chose, you may need to enter more details. For example, you may be prompted to select the type of seller you are in Property or add more details like make and model in Motors. To enter any of these details, tap into that section and enter the required information.
 

Location & Contact Methods

  1. To change your location or contact preferences, tap on Location & Contact.
  2. Choose your contact method by turning the sliders to the right (on) or left (off). If you’ve chosen phone, tap on the Phone section to type in your preferred contact number.
  3. To change your location, tap on Location.
  4. You can either manually enter a street address or postal code, or tap on the location sensor button to have the app automatically enter your location. Addresses are automatically shown as a general area, but if you want to make your exact location available, tap on Show my full address.
  5. When you’re finished, tap Save.
  6. Double check all of your contact and location details, then tap Save again.
 

Finishing Up

  1. If you want to see what your ad will look like when it’s posted, tap Preview Ad. When you’re satisfied that all the information in your ad is correct, tap Post Ad.
  2. You can now choose to feature your ad (or tap Skip at the top of the page). If your ad doesn’t require a listing fee and you’ve chosen not to feature it, skip to step 5.
  3. After you’ve chosen a feature (or if your ad requires a listing fee), start the payment process by tapping Checkout.
  4. On the next screen, choose to pay through either PayPal or credit card. If using PayPal, tap Pay with PayPal and follow the prompts. If using a credit card, tap on the card type and select the type of card you’re using. Tap into each of the fields to enter your card number, expiry and CSC number. When you’re finished, tap Pay Now.
  5. Tap Done!
 

Not letting you post?

If you receive a “please fill out all required fields” error or see a section highlighted in red, it means that there is information missing. Click into the red section and enter the requested information.

Note: After creating your ad, it gets sent to our internal systems. Processing times can change depending on how busy the site is at the time. If it's taking a little longer than expected, please bear with us. Once it goes live we’ll send you an email to confirm and a link to your ad.

Title: Creating a Gumtree Jobs Account
Summary: Learn how to create an account on Gumtree Jobs.
Description__c:
If you already have an account with Gumtree, you can sign into Gumtree Jobs using the same email and password. If you don’t have a Gumtree account, getting started is quick, easy, and free!

To register:

  1. Click Login at the top of the Gumtree Jobs page.
  2. Click the Register tab.
  3. Enter the name, email, and password you would like to use to login.
  4. Click Register at the bottom of the form.
  5. You will receive a welcome email to the email address you entered in the form. To finalize your account, open the email and click Activate Your Account.

Once your account is active, you will be able to login to both Gumtree and Gumtree Jobs. Need help logging in?

Title: How to Post an Ad
Summary: Learn how to create an ad on Gumtree.
Description__c:
Before you create your ad, make sure you have signed in to your Gumtree account by clicking Login/Register and entering your account information. If you don’t have an account yet, you can register an account in a few minutes before posting.

To post an ad:

  1. Click the Sell button at the top of the Gumtree page.
  2. Type in the name of what you’re selling so we can suggest a category.
  3. Select from the categories shown or click Or browse to find a category. If browsing, continue to select from the subcategories until the Continue button appears.
  4. Enter your post code, then click GO. If you’d rather select from a list of cities, click Select your location instead and choose your city. When you have your location set, click Continue.
  5. Under the Ad Title section, click into the box and type in a descriptive title.
  6. Add pictures to your ad by clicking Add Images and selecting the files from your computer. If you’re having trouble, follow the troubleshooting steps in our I Can't Add Photos article.
  7. Click into the box in the Description section and type in information about your ad. Be as detailed as possible. If you're not sure what information you should add, think about what you would want to know if you were the buyer.
  8. Enter the price using numbers only. The pound symbol and punctuation will be added automatically when you post your ad.
  9. If you have a website that you’d like to include, click the box under Website Link and then enter the URL. We ask for a small charge to apply the URL to your ad. For more information, read our URL Feature article.
  10. Choose your feature options. Features are ways to promote your ad and get more views. If you don’t want to promote your ad, you can skip this section.
  11. Choose your contact method. It defaults to the email linked to your account, but you can choose phone only by selecting phone and then deselecting email.
  12. Double check your ad details. When you’re ready, click Post My Ad.

Note: Ads may take some time to go live to the site. If your ad isn’t visible right away, please be patient. We’ll send you an email to let you know when your ad goes live to the site. You can also check the status of your ad in the Manage My Ads section.

Not letting you post?

If you receive a 'please fill out all required fields' error or see a section highlighted in red, it means that there is information missing or not formatted correctly. Click into the red section. If it was empty, enter the information. If you already had information in that field, try removing any symbols or specialized punctuation. If it's a number-specific field (price, kilometres, etc.), make sure you use numbers only. 

Still having trouble? Try clearing your cookies and cache.

Title: Deactivate Account
Summary: Learn how to deactivate your Gumtree account.
Description__c:
In order to deactivate your account on Gumtree.com, please follow these steps:

  1. Login to the Gumtree account you want to deactivate.
  2. Click on the user menu (after logging in, it will say "Hello" with your user name).
  3. Select My Details from the drop-down list.
  4. Click Deactivate your account.
  5. You’ll be presented with a screen asking for deactivation reasons. Once you have chosen a reason, click Deactivate.

Your account will be deactivated right away. You’ll receive an email to confirm that it has been removed. If you’d like to reactivate your account again later, you can re-register at any time.

Title: Reporting to the Police
Summary: Learn how to decide when to escalate an issue to the authorities and how to file a report.
Description__c:
Most experiences on Gumtree are safe and successful, especially when you follow our Stay Safe Advice. But sadly not everyone has honest intentions.

If you’re worried that your Gumtree trade has broken the law (maybe you suspect goods bought in good faith are stolen), or you’ve been the victim of cyber crime (perhaps you’ve had money stolen from your account with a phishing email), you need to report it. Use these steps to help you decide when to escalate your issue and who to tell.

Try the Seller One More Time

They might have a good reason for being slow to respond or send your item out. Tell them your concerns. If they’re genuine, you might resolve the situation quickly without involving the police.

Decided It’s Fishy? Report It Quickly

For goods you suspect are stolen: report it to your local police station or call 101. For fraud and cyber crime: Report it online to Action Fraud or call 0300 123 2040. In both cases, have the following information to hand:

  • Details of what’s happened, including names, addresses, dates and times
  • Details from the Gumtree trade, like the ad reference number and any emails you or they sent

Next Steps

You’ll get a crime reference number and the authority you reported the crime to will get in touch to tell you what happens next.

A report to Action Fraud will go to the National Fraud Intelligence Bureau (NFIB). They’ll assess whether there’s enough evidence for the police or appropriate law enforcement organisation, like Trading Standards, to investigate.

If the police contact us for more information, we’ll do all we can to help.

Title: Deleting Ads
Summary: Learn how to delete your ads when they've been sold, or you no longer need them.
Description__c:
Whether your item is sold or you want to delete and repost it, removing your ads only takes a moment.

  1. Click on the user menu (after logging in, it will say "Hello" with your user name).
  2. Select Manage My Ads from the drop-down list.
  3. Find the ad you'd like to remove in your list.
  4. Click Delete within the box for that ad. 
  5. Choose either “Yes, my ad was successful” or “No, my ad was not successful”.

Once you’ve told us whether or not your ad was successful, it will be removed from the listings right away. After it’s removed, you can still view the ad in your Inactive Ads section. Ads listed in this section are visible only to you.

Note: Ads in your Inactive Ads section cannot be removed.

 

Deleted your ad by accident?

No problem! You can restore any of your deleted ads for free as long as they haven't expired. To restore your ad:

  1. Click on the user menu (after logging in, it will say "Hello" with your user name).
  2. Select Manage My Ads from the drop-down list.
  3. Change the Active Ads menu to Inactive Ads.
  4. Find the ad you'd like to restore and click Edit. 
  5. Double check that the details are correct, and then click Update My Ad.

Title: Deactivating Your Account
Summary: Learn how to disable or delete your Gumtree account.
Description__c:
Accounts can only be deactivated from the main Gumtree site, not the app. If you're using a phone or tablet, go to Gumtree from your device's browser.

To deactivate your account on Gumtree.com:

  1. Login to Gumtree.com with account you want to deactivate. Note: Accounts can only be deactivated from the main site, not the app.
  2. Click on the user menu  at the top of the page.
  3. Select My Details from the drop-down list.

Title: Where Is My Ad?
Summary: Learn how to find ads that have disappeared from the site, or that you're having trouble finding in the search.
Description__c:
Once your ad is created, it goes through our moderation process and will be reviewed by our team. If you are unable to see your live ad after 3 hours, the first step is to check in My Gumtree if the ad is active or inactive.

Checking If Your Ad Is Active:

  1. Make sure you're logged into the correct account, then click on the user menu  at the top of the page.
  2. Select Manage My Ads.
  3. The Manage My Ads page defaults to active ads. If you don't see your ad there, click Inactive Ads.

If Your Ad is Active

If your ad is active but you can’t find it on the site, remember to include your local area as well as your ad’s category in the search bar. Looking in too wide an area or category can make even highly ranked ads hard to find.

If you’re using keywords and still cannot find your ads, remember that keywords need to match your ad's title. Double check that the words you’re using are included in your title and are spelled the same way.

If Your Ad is Inactive

Your ad will be marked with the reason it is inactive. Hover over the information icon to see an explanation. Here's a cheat sheet:

  • Deleted: Deleted ads have been removed from the user end. They can be reactivated at any time by clicking Repost.
  • Expired: Expired ads have finished their full run-time on the site. Learn more about expired ads.
  • Removed: Ads are removed from our end if we believe it breaches one or more of our posting rules. If we need to remove your ad, you'll receive an email explaining which policy was broken.
  • Needs Editing: Ads are occasionally placed in edit mode from our end. We will send you an email telling you what needs to be tweaked. Once that’s done, the advert is good to go.
  • Processing: Ads can take some time to go through our systems. The exact amount of time depends on the ad and how busy Gumtree is at the time. You'll receive an email to let you know when it's officially gone live.

Haven't received an email? Make sure to check both your inbox and spam folder.

Title: I Can't Find My Ad
Summary: Learn how to find ads that have disappeared from the site.
Description__c:
Vanishing ad? If your ad was live but has disappeared, there are a few reasons this might happen.

Has it expired?

From when you post it, your ad will be live for 30 days in every category except Services, Property and Jobs where it will be live for 60 days. Look in My Gumtree > Manage My Ads. You’ll see your inactive ads here. Applying a Bump Up feature will reset your ad's timer to be live for another 30 days. 

 

Have you missed an email from us?

Check your inbox or spam folder because we’ll always contact you if we need you to edit or delete your ad, or block your account. These actions could make your ad disappear, or at least move it to an edit state in your My Gumtree account until you fix the problem.

We might do this if we spot, or another user reports, something wrong with your ad. Don’t worry – our email will explain what’s happened and what you need to do to put things right.

 

Can't find it in the queues?

If your ad is active but you can’t find it on the site, remember to include your local area as well as your ad’s category in the search bar. Looking in too wide an area or category can make even highly ranked ads hard to find.

If you’re using keywords and still cannot find your ads, remember that keywords need to be exact. Double check that the words you’re using to search are actually included in your ad, and are spelled the same way.

 

If you just posted your ad, please see the "Where Is My Ad?" article.

Title: I Can't Edit My Ad
Summary: Learn how to fix common issues that appear after an ad is posted or edited.
Description__c:
For general help editing your ad, read our How to Edit an Ad article. If your ad didn't change after editing it, read the related section below to learn what may have caused the issue.

Price

If the price isn't showing on your ad the way you wanted, you may have used the wrong format. The Price field will only accept whole numbers, with no spaces or symbols. For example, if you wanted to list your item for £17,000 you would need to enter it as 17000. The pound symbol and punctuation will be added automatically afterward.

URLs

URLs can appear in your ad description if you enter a full stop ( . ) without leaving space on one side. For example, if you were to type in ‘In good condition.It is only…’ the section ‘condition.It’ would turn into a URL. Add a space between ‘condition’ and ‘it’ to remove the URL.

Location

Gumtree’s location selection may pick an unexpected area based on your post code. If your ad has already been posted, you will need to create a new ad to fix the location. To avoid this issue, click on the ‘Select your location instead’ button. It can be found just below the post code field when creating your ad. You can then select the location you want your ad to be listed in.

Title: I Can’t Post My Ad
Summary: Learn how to fix the most common ad posting issues.
Description__c:
There are a few common errors you may run into when trying to create your ad. Most of the time, you may just need to edit one of the fields or add more information.

Error Message: ‘Almost there, but it looks like you’ve missed something?’

You’ll see this error when you’re trying to post an ad. It’s caused by one or more of the information fields not being filled out correctly. To find out which field is preventing you from posting, scroll up the page and look for the fields that have an X next to them. They should also have a message below the field explaining how to fix the issue.

‘You must write at least 12 words in your description’

To give you the best chance of selling your item, your ad needs a detailed description. Make sure that you have at least 12 words with spaces between each word.

‘Please enter a price lower than £1,000,000,000’

Prices should be entered as numbers only. The price field won’t accept letters, symbols, or other characters. If you want your price to be £5,300, type in 5300 and the pound symbol will be added in afterward.

‘Please enter a valid URL’

URLs entered in the Post Your Ad page must start with either http:// or https://. If the URL you’re copying doesn’t show this information, click on the beginning of URL within your web browser to expand it.

‘Please select at least one method of contact for your ad’

You can choose if you’d prefer to be contacted by masked email or by phone. But, all ads must have at least one type of contact information included. To fix this error, check the boxes beside either Email or Phone.

‘Your advert description cannot contain website links, please use the Website Link field instead’

When typing your ad description, you may see this error message if you have included a website link in your description or if your ad description is not spaced properly. Please ensure you leave a single space after each full stop, eg (brand new. Available for collection only.)
If you would like to include a URL or website link, you can include this by ticking the Ad website link button. There is a £5.21 charge to use this feature

Still Having Trouble?

If you’ve filled out the field correctly and you’re still unable to post your ad, read our I Can’t Click Buttons or Enter Information article.

Title: Creating Effective Ads
Summary: Learn how to make your ads the best they can be and get more views.
Description__c:
It is easy to post an ad online quickly. But, if you want to sell your item fast, spending some time on your ad will help to catch a buyer’s eye. There are many ways make an effective classified ad. Here are a few tips from our experts:

Create Titles that Attract

Gumtree searches use the keywords included in the title of your ad. To make sure that your ad appears for as many buyers as possible, use detailed, specific keywords. Gumtree allows up to 100 characters – don’t be afraid to use them all.

Example: The title 'sofa for sale' may be accurate but it won’t return a lot of results. Try adding more detail: 'Incredibly comfortable, 3-seater sofa for sale. Red Fabric. Barely used, still in great condition.'

Add Detailed Photos

Ads with photos get more serious replies than those without. Adding well lit, good quality images to your ad will go a long way in catching a buyer's interest. There is no cost to post a picture on Gumtree, so take advantage and include multiple images in your ads.

Choose the Category Carefully

It's important to post your ad to the correct city and category. If your ad is miscategorised, interested buyers may have a difficult time finding it. Double check which category ads like yours are usually in and try posting in that category. After checking your category, double check the city your ad is posted in. If locals can’t see it, it will negatively affect your number of responses.

Compare Your Price

One of the most common mistakes that new sellers make is listing their items at too high a price. If your item is used, buyers expect a bit of a deal. Look for similar ads on the site to see how other sellers are listing their items. Comparing your price to others should help you gauge the range you want to be in.

Promote Your Ads

Sometimes, an ad might need a little boost to get the exposure it deserves. Free classifieds are a great start, but if you want more exposure, consider upgrading your free advertisement with a paid feature.

Ready to post? Good luck.

Title: How do I post an Ad in For Sale?
Summary: Learn how to post ads in the For Sale category.
Description__c:
Before you create your ad, make sure you have signed in to your Gumtree account by clicking Login/Register and entering your account information. If you don’t have an account yet, you can register an account in a few minutes before posting.

To post an ad:

  1. Click the Post an Ad button at the top of the Gumtree page.
  2. Type in the name of what you’re selling so we can suggest the most appropriate category.
  3. Select from the categories shown or click “Or browse to find a category” if none of the selections are appropriate. If browsing, continue to select from the subcategories until the Continue button appears.
  4. Enter your post code, then click GO. If you’d rather select from a list of cities, click “Select your location instead” and choose your city, then click Continue.
  5. Under the Ad Title section, click into the box and type in a descriptive title.
  6. Add pictures to your ad by clicking Add Images and selecting the files from your computer. If you’re having trouble, follow the troubleshooting steps in our Photo Upload Issues article.
  7. Click into the box in the Description section and type in everything that a buyer will need to know. Make sure to be as detailed as possible. Adding more information about your item will help save time by reducing the number of questions that a buyer may need to ask.
  8. Enter the price of your item. Please be sure to enter numbers only.
  9. If you have a website that you’d like to include in your ad, click the box under Website Link and then enter the URL. Please note that there is a small charge.
  10. Choose your feature options. Features are ways to promote your ad and get more views. If you don’t want to promote your ad, you can skip this section.
  11. Choose your contact method. It defaults to the email linked to your account, but if you’d prefer, you can choose phone only by selecting phone and then deselecting email.
  12. Double check your ad details. When you’re ready, click Post My Ad.

Note: Ads may take some time to go live to the site. If your ad isn’t visible right away, please be patient. When your ad goes live to the site, we’ll send you an email to let you know. You can also check the status of your ad in the Manage My Ads section.

 

Posting Errors

If you’re seeing an error when you click Post My Ad, scroll back up. The field that’s causing trouble should have an error note beside it and be outlined in red. Once you’ve fixed the error, try clicking Post My Ad again.

Still having trouble? Try clearing your cookies and cache.

Title: Reviews
Summary: Learn how to rate and review a seller, as well as how to check your own reviews.
Description__c:
When buying or selling in the For Sale categories, you’ll have the option to rate the other user. Ratings encourage fair trading and help you make informed decisions before taking someone up on their offer.

Rating Other Users

As a buyer or seller, you can leave a rating after a number of messages have been sent back and forth between you and the other user. You will see the Rate Buyer/ Seller button if you are the seller, in your conversation window. 

To leave a rating

  1. Select Messages.
  2. Select the conversation with the member you would like to rate.
  3. At the bottom of the conversation, click Rate Buyer/Seller.
  4. Select a star rating based on your overall interaction, then click Submit/Next.
  5. Select the reasons that you gave them that rating. You can select as many reasons as you want. To unselect a reason, click on it again.
  6. Click Submit.

Your rating will appear on the buyer or seller’s account immediately after they’ve rated you. If they don’t leave a rating, it will appear after 5-days.

Viewing Other User’s Reviews

As long as a buyer or seller has reviews on their profile, you’ll see their average star rating at the top of their messages, if using the Gumtree website.
If using the Gumtree app, you will need to click on the three dots next to the users name at the top of the page and select View Profile. You will now be able to see the users listings, Star Rating and any reviews.

To see a sellers reviews:

  1. While viewing the ad, click on the stars under the sellers name in the contact section of the ad, or use the arrow next to the name. 
  2. Click the Reviews tab.
  3. Reviews are sorted from newest to oldest.

Viewing Your Own Reviews

You can see new ratings on your account after you’ve reviewed the other user. If you don’t leave them a review, their review will show on your account after 5-days.
You can see your own reviews exactly as they appear to other users.

To see your reviews:

  1. You should be logged in to see your reviews.
  2. Select My Details from the drop-down menu.
  3. If you have reviews, you will see your average star rating and a button called View profile. 
  4. Click View profile and select the reviews tab.
  5. You’ll be taken to the same page that buyers see when they view your profile. Reviews are sorted from newest to oldest.

Title: How to Register
Summary: Learn how to register an account with Gumtree and find the confirmation email.
Description__c:
At Gumtree, we require members to create an account before they can post ads or send messages. Getting started is quick, easy and free!

To register:

  1. Click Login/Register at the top of the Gumtree homepage.
  2. Click the Register tab.
  3. Enter your name, email, and the password you would like to use to sign into Gumtree. 
  4. Click Register at the bottom of the form.
  5. You will receive a welcome email to the address you entered in the form. To finalize your account, open the email and click Activate Your Account.

You're all set! You should now be able to login and begin your Gumtree journey. For help logging in, click here.
 

No Welcome Email?

If you haven't received your welcome email, check your email's junk and/or spam folders. Then, make sure to add noreply@gumtree.com to your email’s safe list.

Title: Reporting an Ad
Summary: Learn how to report an ad or user if you've encountered something suspicious or inappropriate on the site.
Description__c:
At Gumtree, we rely on our community to help us keep everything as it should be.

Reporting an ad

You can report any ad from its page. You’ll find the report button on the right, just below the seller’s contact details. Please report an ad if you think it’s:

  • illegal or fraudulent
  • spam
  • a duplicate
  • in the wrong category
  • against posting rules

Share any information you think is relevant. Read through our safety advice and review our posting rules and you’ll be a shining example of how to keep yourself and other users safe on Gumtree.

Title: How to change your password
Summary: Learn how to reset your Gumtree password.
Description__c:
To change your password on Gumtree.com please follow these steps:

1. Log into your Gumtree.com account.

2.  Click on the 'My Details' tab



3.  Choose edit in the first section of your 'My Details' page.



4.  Create a new password as per the instructions and click the 'Change my password' box.

Title: Changing Your Password
Summary: Learn how to reset your password for Gumtree if you forgot it or you can't login.
Description__c:
To change your password on Gumtree.com please follow these steps:

  1. Click Login/Register.
  2. From the Login page, click Forgot your password?.
  3. Enter the email you use to login. Note: This may be different from the email you receive messages through.
  4. Click Reset Password.
  5. You will receive a reset email. When you get it, click the link in the email.
  6. The link should open a new page that allows you to enter your a password. Enter it in both fields, and check that it matches. Note: Passwords must be at least 6 characters long, and include at least one number or one special character (@,#,$, etc.).
  7. When you've entered your new password in both fields, click Reset password.

Your password will be reset immediately. You will then be able to login using your email and your new password.

Not Getting the Password Reset Email?

If you don't see the password reset email within 20 minutes of requesting a password change, check your email's junk and/or spam folders. Please also add noreply@gumtree.com to your email's safe senders list.

Title: Disputes with Gumtree
Summary: Learn how to resolve disputes with Gumtree.
Description__c:
If we’ve let you down in any way, we’re sorry. We’ll try to put it right.

Please contact us as soon as you can. One of our support people will be in touch within 24 hours. They’ll speak with you to understand what’s gone wrong and try their best to resolve it.

Title: Using Draft Ads
Summary: Learn how to save an ad as a draft and how to delete drafts that you don’t need.
Description__c:
You put time, effort, and love into your ads. But sometimes, you need to step away for a moment. Gumtree has you covered. If you start creating an ad and need to move on to something else, we’ll save the details you’ve already entered as a draft ad. No need to click anything or go through a complicated process. As long as you’ve already filled out the title, category, and price, we’ll save your ad automatically when you leave the Post an Ad page.

Using a draft ad:

  1. Click on Post an Ad.
  2. If you have a draft ad, you'll see a message asking if you want to use it. Click Load saved draft.
  3. An option will appear asking if you would like to save it as a draft, click save.
  4. The details saved from the last ad you were making will be filled in. Continue adding information or editing as needed.
  5. When you’re happy with your ad, click Post My Ad. If you’re not ready, you can leave the page and your changes will be saved into the draft.

Deleting a draft ad:

  1. Click on Post an Ad.
  2. If you have a draft ad, you'll see a message asking if you want to use it. Click No thanks.

Note: Only one draft ad can be saved at a time. If you click No thanks and start a new ad, that draft deleted.

Title: Saving & Deleting Favourites
Summary: Learn how to save an ad in your Favourites or delete an ad from your Favourites.
Description__c:
Gumtree’s Favourites section allows you to quickly mark an ad that you want to keep an eye on or come back to later.

Saving an Ad to Favourites

There are two ways to save an ad to your favourites. You can click Save Ad (heart icon) on any ad in the search results or you can click Favourite after opening the ad. When the heart icon turns pink, the ad is saved into your favourites.

Removing an Ad from Favourites

If you are viewing the ad in the search results or on the ad detail page, you can click the Save Ad/Favourite button again to remove it from your favourites. If the heart is no longer pink, it has been removed.

To remove multiple ads from your favourites:

  1. Click on the user menu .
  2. Select Favourites from the drop-down menu.
  3. Click Save Ad (heart icon) to de-select it. The ad will be removed from your Favourites right away.

Ads Disappearing from Favourites

The Favourites section is limited to 99 saved ads at a time. Saving a new ad when you’re at the limit will automatically remove the oldest Favourite in your list. If a seller deletes their ad, it will also be removed from your list.

Having trouble?

If ads won’t save to your favourites or are disappearing (and you are not at the 99-ad limit), try clearing your browser’s cookies and cache.

Title: Searching Effectively
Summary: Learn how to search Gumtree so that you can find the ad you’re looking for faster and easier.
Description__c:
Gumtree offers 4 searching tools that will help you narrow in on that perfect item you’re looking for. Get to know how they each work to make the most of your searches.

I’m looking for…

The ‘I’m looking for…’ field is a keyword search. It matches what you type in to the titles of ads on Gumtree. Choose your keywords carefully. If all of the words you type in are not in the title, the ad won’t appear in your search results.

Postcode or Location

The ‘Postcode or location’ field will limit your search results to a specific region. As you type in your location, you will see a drop-down list of options. If you don’t see your area appear, try an area nearby.

Category

Once you’ve started your search, you will see a section titled Category on the left side of the screen (if you’re using a small screen, you can find them by clicking Refine, then Category). You can select from the list of categories and subcategories. Choose the most specific category you can to get the most relevant results.

Filters

Filters allow you to limit your searches to ads with a specific attribute. After you begin your search, filter options will appear on the left side of the search results page (if you’re using a small screen, you can find them by clicking Refine).

The basic filters are:

  • Distance from your location
  • Price minimum and maximum
  • Ads with pictures
  • Search title & description
  • Urgent or Feature ads

There are also category-specific filters in some sections (e.g., Property type filter in the Property for Rent category or the mileage filter in Motors). After you’ve started a basic search, remember to check what filter options are available.

How to Get Better Results

Change Up Your Keywords

Everyone phrases things differently. If you’re not finding what you’re looking for, try changing out the words.

Example: You’re looking for a lawn mowing service but haven’t found many ads in your area. Try searching for ‘grass cutting’ or ‘garden maintenance’ instead. All sellers phrase things differently, so rephrase and try different combinations.

Use a Filter in Place of a Keyword

Most sellers on Gumtree are not professional advertisers. They often don’t put the most relevant keywords in their titles. They may include spelling mistakes. Using filters will show ads that match your needs.

Example: You’re looking for a black hatchback under £5000, that is also within 30 minutes of London. Typing in ‘Black hatchback 30 minutes from London £5000’ is unlikely to get a lot of results. Instead, you can use filters for each of those attributes. If you want something not included in the filters (e.g., heated seats), you can add keywords for that detail.

Select the Most Specific Category

Some categories, like For Sale, have multiple levels of subcategories. The more specific the category you select, the more relevant your results will be.

Example: You’re looking for a new kitchen table. When you search using the keyword ‘table’ you’re seeing ads for bedside tables, table tennis, and more. Selecting the subcategory Dining Tables & Chairs will remove the everything other than kitchen tables.

Title: Sending & Receiving Messages on the Android App
Summary: Learn how to send messages through Gumtree, respond to other members, and remove your conversations.
Description__c:
Whether you’re buying, selling, or offering a service - good communication is important. Here’s how to get started!

Messaging an ad

  1. Open the ad you’re interested in.
  2. Tap Message (it looks like a speech bubble).
  3. Tap into the Write Message box and type in your message.
  4. When you’re finished, tap the send button (it looks like a paper airplane).

You should see your message appear in the section above. That means it’s sent! To see all of your open conversations, tap on the main menu in the top left corner, then select My Messages.

 

Receiving and Responding to Replies

When someone replies to you, you’ll get a notification in your email. If you’re using the Gumtree app, you can opt-in for phone notifications as well.

To respond:

  1. Tap on the main menu.
  2. Select My Messages.
  3. Tap on the conversation you want to open. You should see the entire history of your messages back and forth. To see more, scroll up.
  4. Type your response into the Write Message box.
  5. When you’re finished, tap the send button (it looks like a paper airplane).
 

Deleting Conversations

  1. Tap on the main menu.
  2. Select My Messages.
  3. Tap and hold over the message you want to delete until it turns grey and the Delete button (rubbish bin) appears at the top of the screen.
  4. Select all of the conversations you’d like to remove.
  5. Tap Delete.

After removing a conversation, it won’t be visible in your Inbox anymore. However, if you still have the email copy, you can reply there and the conversation history will reappear in your Inbox after a new message is sent.

Title: Sending & Receiving Messages
Summary: Learn how to send messages through Gumtree, respond to other members, and remove your conversations.
Description__c:
Whether you’re buying, selling, or offering a service – being able to talk to each other is the heart of any deal. Here's how to get started.

Sending Messages to an Ad

  1. Contact the seller of an item by clicking the Email button found under the Contact Details section of an ad. 
  2. Type your message into the box. Remember, detailed messages mean less back and forth and more time to enjoy your day.
  3. Click Send.

Receiving Messages and Sending Replies

When someone replies, you'll get their message in two places. The first copy will go into the Messages section of your account. The second copy will be sent to the email address linked to your account.

Replying by Email

To respond directly from your email, hit the reply button as you would with any other email. Don’t worry, your email will be masked.

Replying in the Messages Section

  1. Log into your account, then click on the user menu at the top of the page.
  2. Select Messages.
  3. Click on the conversation you’d like to reply to.
  4. Type your message into the box that says 'Send message to…'
  5. Click Send Message.

Deleting Conversations

  1. Log into your account and click on the user menu at the top of the page.
  2. Select Messages.
  3. Click on the conversation you’d like to remove.
  4. Select Delete Conversation.

Tip: After deleting a conversation, it won’t be visible in the Messages section. However, if you still have the email copy, you can reply there. After a new email is sent, it will reappear in Messages.
 

Can't See Your Messages?

If you have a reply in Messages but aren’t seeing the email version, you may need to add noreply@gumtree.com and the domain @reply.gumtree.com to your email safe list. This will prevent messages from getting caught by your email’s filters. Remember to check your junk and/or spam folders as well. 

Technical Issues

If you're having issues with your messages, please read the most appropriate article listed below:

  • I'm Not Receiving Replies
  • I Can't Send Replies
  • Can I Turn Off Email Messages?

Title: Creating & Managing Alerts in Jobs
Summary: Learn how to set up, edit, and delete alerts in Gumtree Jobs.
Description__c:
Alerts keep an eye on the queues when you’re too busy. Set it up, go about your day and wait for the ads to come to you!

Creating your alert:

  1. Click Get job alerts from the top bar.
  2. Fill in the details of the type of job you’re looking for. For best results, make sure to enter anything that you consider necessary in a job.
  3. Click Email me jobs like this.

You’re done! You should now see your alert within the My Job Alerts page. Alerts are sent out every day if there are new search results. If there are no new results, an alert will not be sent out.

Tip: Want to see the types of ads that your alert is finding beforehand? Go into My Job Alerts, and click Preview next to the alert you want to check.

Editing your alerts:

  1. Open the Gumtree Jobs menu.
  2. Select My Jobs Alerts from the drop-down list. 
  3. You should see a list of all of your alerts. Click Edit next to the one you’d like to change. 
  4. You’ll be brought back to alert details screen. Change the filters as needed. 
  5. Click Email me jobs like this to save the alert.

Deleting alerts:

  1. Open the Gumtree Jobs menu.
  2. Select My Job Alerts from the drop-down list. 
  3. Click Delete next to the alert you’d like to remove. 

Not receiving your Alert emails? Make sure that you check your junk and/or spam filters and add email@Gumtreejobs.com to your safe senders list.

Title: Creating & Managing Alerts in the Android App
Summary: Learn how to set up, edit, and delete alerts using the Android App.
Description__c:
Alerts keep an eye on the queues when you’re too busy. Set it up, go about your day and wait for the ads to come to you!

Creating your alert:

  7. Tap the 3-dot menu again, then Save Search again to create the new version based on the filters you’ve chosen.
